 253+ E937              ;   Z is normalised to 9 bits (256..511) with a barrel shift (count from a
 254+ E937              ;   log2 table) that is also applied to X and Y, which are then multiplied
 255+ E937              ;   by a 16-bit reciprocal from rtab.  |X| <= Z keeps Xn within 9 bits.
 256+ E937              ;==============================================================================
 257+ E937              project:
 258+ E937 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 259+ E938 23                   inc hl
 260+ E939 46                   ld b,(hl)
 261+ E93A 23                   inc hl                          ; BC = X
 262+ E93B 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 263+ E93C 23                   inc hl
 264+ E93D 56                   ld d,(hl)
 265+ E93E 23                   inc hl                          ; DE = Y
 266+ E93F D5                   push de
 267+ E940 C5                   push bc
 268+ E941 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 269+ E942 23                   inc hl
 270+ E943 66                   ld h,(hl)
 271+ E944 6F                   ld l,a                          ; HL = Z
 272+ E945 CD 88 E9             call zpatch
 273+ E948
 274+ E948 E1                   pop hl                          ; X
 275+ E949 7C                   ld a,h
 276+ E94A F5                   push af
 277+ E94B CD E6 EB             call scale_comp
 278+ E94E 4F                   ld c,a
 279+ E94F F1                   pop af
 280+ E950 17                   rla
 281+ E951 38 09                jr c,.xn
 282+ E953 3E 80                ld a,128
 283+ E955 81                   add a,c
 284+ E956 30 0A                jr nc,.xd
 285+ E958 3E FF                ld a,255
 286+ E95A 18 06                jr .xd
 287+ E95C 3E 80        .xn:    ld a,128
 288+ E95E 91                   sub c
 289+ E95F 30 01                jr nc,.xd
 290+ E961 AF                   xor a
 291+ E962 32 E6 E0     .xd:    ld (pj_sx),a
 292+ E965
 293+ E965 E1                   pop hl                          ; Y
 294+ E966                      ; fall through
 295+ E966
 296+ E966              ; HL = Y -> C = screen y, A = screen x of the last project.  Uses the Z
 297+ E966              ; patched into scale_comp by the last project, so on its own it projects a
 298+ E966              ; point straight above or below that one when pitch is 0 (same X and Z).
 299+ E966              proj_y:
 300+ E966 7C                   ld a,h
 301+ E967 F5                   push af
 302+ E968 CD E6 EB             call scale_comp
 303+ E96B 4F                   ld c,a
 304+ E96C F1                   pop af
 305+ E96D 17                   rla
 306+ E96E 38 08                jr c,.yn
 307+ E970 3E 40                ld a,VIEW_CY
 308+ E972 91                   sub c
 309+ E973 30 0E                jr nc,.yd
 310+ E975 AF                   xor a
 311+ E976 18 0B                jr .yd
 312+ E978 3E 40        .yn:    ld a,VIEW_CY
 313+ E97A 81                   add a,c
 314+ E97B 38 04                jr c,.yc
 315+ E97D FE 80                cp VIEW_H
 316+ E97F 38 02                jr c,.yd
 317+ E981 3E 7F        .yc:    ld a,VIEW_H-1
 318+ E983 4F           .yd:    ld c,a
 319+ E984 3A E6 E0             ld a,(pj_sx)
 320+ E987 C9                   ret
 321+ E988
 322+ E988              ; HL = Z (camera space): normalise it and patch its shift and reciprocal
 323+ E988              ; into scale_comp, which then gives A = |component| * 128 / Z
 324+ E988              zpatch:
 325+ E988 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 326+ E98A 20 03                jr nz,.z1
 327+ E98C B4                   or h
 328+ E98D 20 03                jr nz,.zok
 329+ E98F 21 01 00     .z1:    ld hl,1
 330+ E992 7C           .zok:   ld a,h
 331+ E993 FE 02                cp 2
 332+ E995 38 0D                jr c,.lt512
 333+ E997 5F                   ld e,a                          ; Z >= 512: shift right by log2(H)
 334+ E998 16 E6                ld d,high lgtab
 335+ E99A 1A                   ld a,(de)
 336+ E99B 47                   ld b,a
 337+ E99C EB                   ex de,hl
 338+ E99D ED 2A                bsrl de,b
 339+ E99F EB                   ex de,hl
 340+ E9A0 0E 2A                ld c,OP_BSRL                    ; (scale_comp: right)
 341+ E9A2 18 16                jr .nrm
 342+ E9A4 06 00        .lt512: ld b,0
 343+ E9A6 0E 2A                ld c,OP_BSRL                    ; (right by 0: as it is)
 344+ E9A8 B7                   or a
 345+ E9A9 20 0F                jr nz,.nrm                      ; 256..511 already normalised
 346+ E9AB 5D                   ld e,l                          ; Z < 256: shift left by 8-log2(L)
 347+ E9AC 16 E6                ld d,high lgtab
 348+ E9AE 1A                   ld a,(de)
 349+ E9AF D6 08                sub 8
 350+ E9B1 ED 44                neg
 351+ E9B3 47                   ld b,a                          ; the count
 352+ E9B4 EB                   ex de,hl
 353+ E9B5 ED 28                bsla de,b
 354+ E9B7 EB                   ex de,hl
 355+ E9B8 0E 28                ld c,OP_BSLA                    ; (scale_comp: left)
 356+ E9BA 78           .nrm:   ld a,b                          ; patch shift and reciprocal into
 357+ E9BB 32 F2 EB             ld (scale_comp.sh+1),a          ; scale_comp's immediates: the shift's
 358+ E9BE 79                   ld a,c                          ; count and its opcode (the barrel
 359+ E9BF 32 F4 EB             ld (scale_comp.op+1),a          ; shift's second byte: which way)
 360+ E9C2 26 E4                ld h,high rtab_lo               ; L = Zn - 256
 361+ E9C4 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 362+ E9C5 32 FE EB             ld (scale_comp.rl+1),a
 363+ E9C8 32 14 EC             ld (scale_comp.r16+1),a
 364+ E9CB 24                   inc h
 365+ E9CC 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 366+ E9CD 32 04 EC             ld (scale_comp.rh+1),a
 367+ E9D0 32 15 EC             ld (scale_comp.r16+2),a
 368+ E9D3 C9                   ret
 369+ E9D4
 370+ E9D4                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 371+ E9D4              ;==============================================================================
 372+ E9D4              ; 2D clip of the current face (df_ptr, df_mask), no corner behind the near
 373+ E9D4              ; plane.  Carry set: a corner is outside the guard band (nothing drawn, clip
 374+ E9D4              ; it in 3D).  Else p2buf / p2n hold the clipped polygon (p2n < 3: none).
 375+ E9D4              ; The corners go into clipA as x, y (16-bit screen), pad, edge flag (+6),
 376+ E9D4              ; pad, and are clipped by clip_poly with clip_plane = $80: plane_dist and
 377+ E9D4              ; clip_isect then work on the 2D plane c2_off / c2_hi, one of x >= 0,
 378+ E9D4              ; x <= 255, y >= 0, y <= VIEW_H-1, and only those some corner is outside.
 379+ E9D4              ;==============================================================================
 380+ E9D4              clip2d:
 381+ E9D4 2A C0 E0             ld hl,(df_ptr)
 382+ E9D7 FD 21 9B E1          ld iy,clipA
 383+ E9DB 3A C3 E0             ld a,(df_mask)
 384+ E9DE 32 C4 E0             ld (df_m),a
 385+ E9E1 AF                   xor a
 386+ E9E2 32 DB E0             ld (c2_or),a                    ; the planes the corners cross
 387+ E9E5 06 04                ld b,4
 388+ E9E7 C5           .cp:    push bc
 389+ E9E8 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 390+ E9E9 23                   inc hl
 391+ E9EA E5                   push hl
 392+ E9EB 6F                   ld l,a
 393+ E9EC 3A BF F8             ld a,(vtx_hi)
 394+ E9EF 67                   ld h,a
 395+ E9F0 E5                   push hl
 396+ E9F1 DD E1                pop ix                          ; IX -> the corner
 397+ E9F3 DD 7E 06             ld a,(ix+6)
 398+ E9F6 B7                   or a
 399+ E9F7 20 16                jr nz,.off
 400+ E9F9 DD 7E 07             ld a,(ix+7)                     ; on screen: its cached sx, sy
 401+ E9FC FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 402+ E9FF FD 36 01 00          ld (iy+1),0
 403+ EA03 DD 7E 08             ld a,(ix+8)
 404+ EA06 FD 77 02             ld (iy+2),a
 405+ EA09 FD 36 03 00          ld (iy+3),0
 406+ EA0D 18 06                jr .fl
 407+ EA0F CD 99 EA     .off:   call guard_proj
 408+ EA12 DA 95 EA             jp c,.fail
 409+ EA15 3A C4 E0     .fl:    ld a,(df_m)                     ; edge flag from the mask
 410+ EA18 5F                   ld e,a
 411+ EA19 E6 01                and 1
 412+ EA1B FD 77 06             ld (iy+6),a
 413+ EA1E 7B                   ld a,e
 414+ EA1F 0F                   rrca
 415+ EA20 32 C4 E0             ld (df_m),a
 416+ EA23 11 08 00             ld de,8
 417+ EA26 FD 19                add iy,de
 418+ EA28 E1                   pop hl
 419+ EA29 C1                   pop bc
 420+ EA2A 10 BB                djnz .cp
 421+ EA2C
 422+ EA2C 3E 04                ld a,4
 423+ EA2E 32 C6 E0             ld (clip_n),a
 424+ EA31 21 9B E1             ld hl,clipA
 425+ EA34 22 CA E0             ld (clip_src),hl
 426+ EA37 21 F6 F8             ld hl,clipB
 427+ EA3A 22 CC E0             ld (clip_dst),hl
 428+ EA3D 3E 80                ld a,$80
 429+ EA3F 32 C9 E0             ld (clip_plane),a               ; (a 2D plane)
 430+ EA42 21 DE E0             ld hl,c2_planes
 431+ EA45 3A DB E0     .pl:    ld a,(c2_or)
 432+ EA48 CB 3F                srl a
 433+ EA4A 32 DB E0             ld (c2_or),a
 434+ EA4D 30 16                jr nc,.skip
 435+ EA4F 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 436+ EA50 32 DC E0             ld (c2_off),a
 437+ EA53 23                   inc hl
 438+ EA54 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 439+ EA55 32 DD E0             ld (c2_hi),a
 440+ EA58 2B                   dec hl
 441+ EA59 E5                   push hl
 442+ EA5A CD CA EC             call clip_poly
 443+ EA5D E1                   pop hl
 444+ EA5E 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 445+ EA61 FE 03                cp 3
 446+ EA63 38 2B                jr c,.none
 447+ EA65 23           .skip:  inc hl
 448+ EA66 23                   inc hl
 449+ EA67 3A DB E0             ld a,(c2_or)
 450+ EA6A B7                   or a
 451+ EA6B 20 D8                jr nz,.pl
 452+ EA6D
 453+ EA6D 2A CA E0             ld hl,(clip_src)                ; to p2buf: all on screen, 8-bit
 454+ EA70 11 80 E0             ld de,p2buf
 455+ EA73 3A C6 E0             ld a,(clip_n)
 456+ EA76 32 E8 E0             ld (p2n),a
 457+ EA79 47                   ld b,a
 458+ EA7A 7E           .o:     ld a,(hl)                       ; x
 459+ EA7B 12                   ld (de),a
 460+ EA7C 13                   inc de
 461+ EA7D 23                   inc hl
 462+ EA7E 23                   inc hl
 463+ EA7F 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; y
 464+ EA80 12                   ld (de),a
 465+ EA81 13                   inc de
 466+ EA82 3E 04                ld a,4
 467+ EA84 ED 31                add hl,a
 468+ EA86 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; edge flag
 469+ EA87 12                   ld (de),a
 470+ EA88 13                   inc de
 471+ EA89 13                   inc de
 472+ EA8A 23                   inc hl
 473+ EA8B 23                   inc hl
 474+ EA8C 10 EC                djnz .o
 475+ EA8E B7                   or a
 476+ EA8F C9                   ret
 477+ EA90 AF           .none:  xor a                           ; (carry clear)
 478+ EA91 32 E8 E0             ld (p2n),a
 479+ EA94 C9                   ret
 480+ EA95 E1           .fail:  pop hl
 481+ EA96 C1                   pop bc
 482+ EA97 37                   scf
 483+ EA98 C9                   ret
 484+ EA99
 485+ EA99              ; IX -> corner (X, Y, Z; Z >= NEAR) -> its screen x, y (16-bit) at IY+0, +2,
 486+ EA99              ; the screen planes it is outside ORed into c2_or.  Carry set (nothing
 487+ EA99              ; stored) if outside the guard band |X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z.
 488+ EA99              guard_proj:
 489+ EA99 DD 6E 04             ld l,(ix+4)
 490+ EA9C DD 66 05             ld h,(ix+5)
 491+ EA9F E5                   push hl                         ; Z
 492+ EAA0 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
 493+ EAA3 DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
 494+ EAA6 CD 41 AF             call abs_hl
 495+ EAA9 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; |X|
 496+ EAAA E1                   pop hl
 497+ EAAB E5                   push hl
 498+ EAAC 29                   add hl,hl                       ; 2Z (carry: over 65535, so more)
 499+ EAAD 38 04                jr c,.g1
 500+ EAAF ED 52                sbc hl,de
 501+ EAB1 38 45                jr c,.out
 502+ EAB3 DD 6E 02     .g1:    ld l,(ix+2)
 503+ EAB6 DD 66 03             ld h,(ix+3)
 504+ EAB9 CD 41 AF             call abs_hl
 505+ EABC EB                   ex de,hl                        ; |Y|
 506+ EABD E1                   pop hl
 507+ EABE E5                   push hl
 508+ EABF B7                   or a
 509+ EAC0 ED 52                sbc hl,de
 510+ EAC2 38 34                jr c,.out
 511+ EAC4 E1                   pop hl
 512+ EAC5 7D                   ld a,l                          ; (zpatch tests HL = 0 with A = L)
 513+ EAC6 CD 88 E9             call zpatch
 514+ EAC9 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)
 515+ EACC DD 66 01             ld h,(ix+1)
 516+ EACF 11 80 00             ld de,128
 517+ EAD2 01 01 FF             ld bc,255<<8|1                  ; x: 0..255, c2_or bits 0, 1
 518+ EAD5 CD FB EA             call c2_scr                     ; 128 + 128X/Z
 519+ EAD8 FD 75 00             ld (iy+0),l
 520+ EADB FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
 521+ EADE DD 6E 02             ld l,(ix+2)
 522+ EAE1 DD 66 03             ld h,(ix+3)
 523+ EAE4 CD 3A AF             call neg_hl
 524+ EAE7 11 40 00             ld de,VIEW_CY
 525+ EAEA 01 04 7F             ld bc,(VIEW_H-1)<<8|4           ; y: 0..VIEW_H-1, c2_or bits 2, 3
 526+ EAED CD FB EA             call c2_scr                     ; VIEW_CY - 128Y/Z
 527+ EAF0 FD 75 02             ld (iy+2),l
 528+ EAF3 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
 529+ EAF6 B7                   or a
 530+ EAF7 C9                   ret
 531+ EAF8 E1           .out:   pop hl
 532+ EAF9 37                   scf
 533+ EAFA C9                   ret
 534+ EAFB
 535+ EAFB              ; HL = component, DE = the screen centre, B = the upper bound, C = the lower
 536+ EAFB              ; plane's c2_or bit (the upper's is the next) -> HL = DE + 128 HL / Z (the
 537+ EAFB              ; Z patched in by zpatch), and the plane it is outside, if any, into c2_or
 538+ EAFB              c2_scr:
 539+ EAFB C5                   push bc
 540+ EAFC D5                   push de
 541+ EAFD 7C                   ld a,h
 542+ EAFE F5                   push af
 543+ EAFF CD 20 EB             call scomp16
 544+ EB02 F1                   pop af
 545+ EB03 17                   rla
 546+ EB04 DC 3A AF             call c,neg_hl
 547+ EB07 D1                   pop de
 548+ EB08 19                   add hl,de
 549+ EB09 C1                   pop bc
 550+ EB0A 7C                   ld a,h
 551+ EB0B B7                   or a
 552+ EB0C 28 05                jr z,.z
 553+ EB0E FA 18 EB             jp m,.lo                        ; < 0
 554+ EB11 18 03                jr .hi                          ; > 255
 555+ EB13 78           .z:     ld a,b
 556+ EB14 BD                   cp l
 557+ EB15 D0                   ret nc                          ; inside
 558+ EB16 CB 21        .hi:    sla c
 559+ EB18 3A DB E0     .lo:    ld a,(c2_or)
 560+ EB1B B1                   or c
 561+ EB1C 32 DB E0             ld (c2_or),a
 562+ EB1F C9                   ret
 563+ EB20
 564+ EB20              ; HL = signed component -> HL = round(|HL| * 128 / Z), |HL| <= 2Z: as
 565+ EB20              ; scale_comp (the same shift and reciprocal, patched into it by zpatch),
 566+ EB20              ; with a 10-bit Xn and a 16-bit result
 567+ EB20              scomp16:
 568+ EB20 CD 41 AF             call abs_hl
 569+ EB23 EB                   ex de,hl
 570+ EB24 3A F2 EB             ld a,(scale_comp.sh+1)          ; the shift zpatch set: its count,
 571+ EB27 47                   ld b,a
 572+ EB28 3A F4 EB             ld a,(scale_comp.op+1)          ; and which way (its opcode)
 573+ EB2B FE 28                cp OP_BSLA
 574+ EB2D 28 04                jr z,.l
 575+ EB2F ED 2A                bsrl de,b
 576+ EB31 18 02                jr .s
 577+ EB33 ED 28        .l:     bsla de,b
 578+ EB35 EB           .s:     ex de,hl
 579+ EB36 7C                   ld a,h
 580+ EB37 FE 04                cp 4
 581+ EB39 38 03                jr c,.ok
 582+ EB3B 21 FF 03             ld hl,1023                      ; (rounding at the guard band's edge)
 583+ EB3E 44           .ok:    ld b,h                          ; bits 8-9 of Xn
 584+ EB3F 3A FE EB             ld a,(scale_comp.rl+1)
 585+ EB42 5F                   ld e,a
 586+ EB43 55                   ld d,l
 587+ EB44 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rl
 588+ EB46 4A                   ld c,d
 589+ EB47 3A 04 EC             ld a,(scale_comp.rh+1)
 590+ EB4A 5F                   ld e,a
 591+ EB4B 55                   ld d,l
 592+ EB4C ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rh
 593+ EB4E 79                   ld a,c
 594+ EB4F 83                   add a,e
 595+ EB50 6F                   ld l,a
 596+ EB51 7A                   ld a,d
 597+ EB52 CE 00                adc a,0
 598+ EB54 67                   ld h,a                          ; HL = (Xl*R) >> 8
 599+ EB55 0E 00                ld c,0
 600+ EB57 78                   ld a,b
 601+ EB58 B7                   or a
 602+ EB59 28 0A                jr z,.nh
 603+ EB5B ED 5B 14 EC          ld de,(scale_comp.r16+1)
 604+ EB5F 19           .ad:    add hl,de                       ; + (256 * Xh * R) >> 8
 605+ EB60 30 01                jr nc,.a1
 606+ EB62 0C                   inc c
 607+ EB63 10 FA        .a1:    djnz .ad
 608+ EB65 24           .nh:    inc h                           ; + rounding (0.5 after >>9)
 609+ EB66 20 01                jr nz,.nr
 610+ EB68 0C                   inc c
 611+ EB69 6C           .nr:    ld l,h
 612+ EB6A 61                   ld h,c
 613+ EB6B CB 3C                srl h
 614+ EB6D CB 1D                rr l                            ; HL = (C:H) >> 1 = P >> 9
 615+ EB6F C9                   ret
 616+ EB70
 617+ EB70              ; clip_isect for a 2D plane: the point where the edge S-E crosses it, out
 618+ EB70              ; at IY (IY and clip_on advanced).  Worked out from the edge's inside end,
 619+ EB70              ; so an edge two faces share is cut at the same point whichever way it
 620+ EB70              ; runs: t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|), the other coordinate o_in + t (o_out -
 621+ EB70              ; o_in), this one exactly on the bound.
 622+ EB70              c2_isect:
 623+ EB70 2A CE E0             ld hl,(clip_s)
 624+ EB73 ED 5B D0 E0          ld de,(clip_e)
 625+ EB77 3A D3 E0             ld a,(clip_ds+1)
 626+ EB7A 17                   rla
 627+ EB7B 30 01                jr nc,.sin
 628+ EB7D EB                   ex de,hl                        ; S outside: E is the inside end
 629+ EB7E 3A DC E0     .sin:   ld a,(c2_off)
 630+ EB81 EE 02                xor 2                           ; the other coordinate
 631+ EB83 ED 31                add hl,a
 632+ EB85 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 633+ EB86 23                   inc hl
 634+ EB87 46                   ld b,(hl)                       ; o_in
 635+ EB88 EB                   ex de,hl
 636+ EB89 ED 31                add hl,a
 637+ EB8B 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 638+ EB8C 23                   inc hl
 639+ EB8D 66                   ld h,(hl)
 640+ EB8E 6F                   ld l,a                          ; o_out
 641+ EB8F B7                   or a
 642+ EB90 ED 42                sbc hl,bc                       ; o_out - o_in
 643+ EB92 28 26                jr z,.same                      ; (a vertical / horizontal edge: o_in)
 644+ EB94 C5                   push bc
 645+ EB95 E5                   push hl
 646+ EB96 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 647+ EB99 CD 41 AF             call abs_hl
 648+ EB9C EB                   ex de,hl
 649+ EB9D 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 650+ EBA0 CD 41 AF             call abs_hl
 651+ EBA3 19                   add hl,de
 652+ EBA4 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; |dS| + |dE|
 653+ EBA5 2A D2 E0             ld hl,(clip_ds)
 654+ EBA8 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 655+ EBAA 28 03                jr z,.di
 656+ EBAC 2A D4 E0             ld hl,(clip_de)
 657+ EBAF CD 83 E8     .di:    call div_frac                   ; t = d_in / (|dS| + |dE|)
 658+ EBB2 E1                   pop hl                          ; o_out - o_in
 659+ EBB3 DD E5                push ix
 660+ EBB5 D1                   pop de
 661+ EBB6 CD 50 E8             call mul_frac
 662+ EBB9 C1                   pop bc
 663+ EBBA 09           .same:  add hl,bc                       ; o_in + t (o_out - o_in)
 664+ EBBB 3A DC E0             ld a,(c2_off)
 665+ EBBE B7                   or a
 666+ EBBF 20 12                jr nz,.y
 667+ EBC1 FD 75 02             ld (iy+2),l                     ; an x plane: y worked out
 668+ EBC4 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h
 669+ EBC7 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 670+ EBCA FD 77 00             ld (iy+0),a
 671+ EBCD FD 36 01 00          ld (iy+1),0
 672+ EBD1 18 10                jr .f
 673+ EBD3 FD 75 00     .y:     ld (iy+0),l                     ; a y plane: x worked out
 674+ EBD6 FD 74 01             ld (iy+1),h
 675+ EBD9 3A DD E0             ld a,(c2_hi)
 676+ EBDC FD 77 02             ld (iy+2),a
 677+ EBDF FD 36 03 00          ld (iy+3),0
 678+ EBE3 C3 50 EE     .f:     jp clip_isect.nz                ; its edge flag, IY and clip_on on
 679+ EBE6                  ENDIF
 680+ EBE6
 681+ EBE6              ; HL = signed component -> A = round(|HL| * 128 / Z)
 682+ EBE6              ; The shift and reciprocal for this Z are patched in by zpatch: the shift
 683+ EBE6              ; as a barrel shift whose count and direction (its opcode, BSRL or BSLA)
 684+ EBE6              ; are both patched, so it runs straight through (a right shift by 0 for a Z
 685+ EBE6              ; already 256..511 leaves it as it is).
 686+ EBE6              scale_comp:
 687+ EBE6 CB 7C                bit 7,h
 688+ EBE8 28 06                jr z,.ap
 689+ EBEA AF                   xor a
 690+ EBEB 95                   sub l
 691+ EBEC 6F                   ld l,a
 692+ EBED 9F                   sbc a,a
 693+ EBEE 94                   sub h
 694+ EBEF 67                   ld h,a
 695+ EBF0 EB           .ap:    ex de,hl
 696+ EBF1 06 00        .sh:    ld b,0                          ; (zpatch: the count)
 697+ EBF3 ED 2A        .op:    bsrl de,b                       ; (zpatch: bsrl, or bsla)
 698+ EBF5 EB                   ex de,hl
 699+ EBF6                      ASSERT {b scale_comp.op} == $ED && {b scale_comp.op+1} == OP_BSRL
 700+ EBF6 7C           .sd:    ld a,h
 701+ EBF7 FE 02                cp 2
 702+ EBF9 30 27                jr nc,.big
 703+ EBFB 44           .ok:    ld b,h                          ; bit 8 of Xn
 704+ EBFC 55                   ld d,l
 705+ EBFD 1E 00        .rl:    ld e,0
 706+ EBFF ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rl
 707+ EC01 4A                   ld c,d
 708+ EC02 55                   ld d,l
 709+ EC03 1E 00        .rh:    ld e,0
 710+ EC05 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rh
 711+ EC07 79                   ld a,c
 712+ EC08 83                   add a,e
 713+ EC09 6F                   ld l,a
 714+ EC0A 7A                   ld a,d
 715+ EC0B CE 00                adc a,0
 716+ EC0D 67                   ld h,a                          ; HL = (Xl*R) >> 8

 721+ EC16 19                   add hl,de                       ; + (256*R) >> 8

 723+ EC19 24           .nh:    inc h                           ; + rounding (0.5 after >>9)

 726+ EC1D 79           .nr:    ld a,c

 729+ EC20 1F                   rra                             ; A = (C:H) >> 1  = P >> 9
 730+ EC21 C9                   ret
 731+ EC22 21 FF 01     .big:   ld hl,511                       ; clamp (rounding at frustum edge)
 732+ EC25 18 D4                jr .ok

 734+ EC27              ;==============================================================================
 735+ EC27              ; Outcode: HL -> vertex (X,Y,Z) -> A = bits
 736+ EC27              ;   1 near (Z<NEAR)  2 left (X<-Z)  4 right (X>Z)
 737+ EC27              ;   8 top (Y>0.5Z)   16 bottom (Y<-0.5Z)
 738+ EC27              ;==============================================================================
 739+ EC27              calc_oc:

 773+ EC55 28 02                jr z,.n3

 789+ EC6F C9                   ret

 791+ EC70                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 792+ EC70              ; plane_dist for a 2D plane (clip2d): IX -> 2D vertex -> HL = its distance
 793+ EC70              ; inside c2_off / c2_hi (>= 0: inside)
 794+ EC70              c2_dist:

 853+ ECCA              ;==============================================================================
 854+ ECCA              ; Sutherland-Hodgman clip of clip_src (clip_n verts) against clip_plane into
 855+ ECCA              ; clip_dst.  Vertex = X,Y,Z,flag,corner (8 bytes).  flag=1 means the edge from
 856+ ECCA              ; this vertex to the next is a real building edge (gets outlined); edges
 857+ ECCA              ; created along a clip plane get flag=0 so the screen border isn't outlined.
 858+ ECCA              ; corner = vtx offset of an unclipped building corner that is on screen, so
 859+ ECCA              ; its cached projection can be reused; $80 + plane bit for a vertex the
 860+ ECCA              ; clipper put on that plane; $FF for any other vertex.

1277+ F049              ;==============================================================================
1278+ F049              ; Convex polygon fill from p2buf (8-bit screen coords).
1279+ F049              ;   Each edge is walked with an exact integer DDA into one of two x tables:
1280+ F049              ;   downward edges -> TA, upward edges -> TB.  For a convex polygon every row
1281+ F049              ;   then has one entry in each, and the span between them is filled.
1282+ F049              ;   Winding doesn't matter.
1283+ F049              ;==============================================================================
1284+ F049              fill_poly:

1352+ F0BC              ; Bresenham style: x += q each row, fractional r/dy accumulated in a biased
1353+ F0BC              ; byte (carry == wrap), so the end point is hit exactly.

1458+ F14A
1459+ F14A              ;==============================================================================
1460+ F14A              ; Span filler.  Rows fy0..fy1, x from TA/TB.  DE = colour pair.
1461+ F14A              ; Short spans use the stack pointer as a 2-byte write pointer into the frame
1462+ F14A              ; buffer (see push_blk), jumping into an unrolled block of PUSH DE.  Spans of
1463+ F14A              ; DMA_SPAN_MIN pixels or more are written by the zxnDMA, which only needs its
1464+ F14A              ; length and destination reloaded (see clear_screen).
1465+ F14A              ; For speed: the stack pointer is kept in IY (ld sp,iy), the rows are
1466+ F14A              ; counted down in IXH, and the table that is the left edge at the polygon's
1467+ F14A              ; middle row is read first, so the left / right swap (still made whenever
1468+ F14A              ; it's needed: a sliver's edges can cross) is mostly skipped.
1469+ F14A              ;==============================================================================
1470+ F14A              fill_spans:
1471+ F14A 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1472+ F14D CD 20 E8             call seg_map                    ; first row's section into slot 0
1473+ F150 FD 21 00 00          ld iy,0
1474+ F154 FD 39                add iy,sp                       ; the stack, for push_end
1475+ F156 3A E9 E0             ld a,(fy0)
1476+ F159 47                   ld b,a

1483+ F165 1F                   rra
1484+ F166 6F                   ld l,a

1490+ F16E 0E 24                ld c,$24                        ;   (inc h)

1493+ F174 0E 25                ld c,$25                        ;   (dec h)
1494+ F176 32 7E F1     .ta:    ld (fs_loop+1),a
1495+ F179 79                   ld a,c
1496+ F17A 32 81 F1             ld (fs_loop.tb),a
1497+ F17D
1498+ F17D              fs_loop:
1499+ F17D 26 E2                ld h,high TA                    ; (patched: the left table first)
1500+ F17F 68                   ld l,b
1501+ F180 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1502+ F181 24           .tb:    inc h                           ; (patched: inc h, or dec h, the other)
1503+ F182 4E                   ld c,(hl)
1504+ F183 B9                   cp c

1506+ F186 69                   ld l,c
1507+ F187 4F                   ld c,a
1508+ F188 7D                   ld a,l
1509+ F189 6F           .ord:   ld l,a                          ; A = left x, C = right x
1510+ F18A 78                   ld a,b
1511+ F18B E6 1F                and 31
1512+ F18D 67                   ld h,a                          ; row within the paged section
1513+ F18E 79                   ld a,c
1514+ F18F 95                   sub l                           ; width-1
1515+ F190 FE 13                cp DMA_SPAN_MIN-1
1516+ F192 30 17                jr nc,.dma
1517+ F194 CB 3F        .push:  srl a
1518+ F196 38 07                jr c,.even
1519+ F198 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; odd width: single pixel first
1520+ F199 B7                   or a
1521+ F19A CA 84 E1             jp z,push_next                  ; (1 pixel: no PUSHes, so SP isn't
1522+ F19D 18 01                jr .go                          ; borrowed: see push_blk)
1523+ F19F 3C           .even:  inc a
1524+ F1A0 69           .go:    ld l,c
1525+ F1A1 23                   inc hl                          ; one past right edge (may be $C000)
1526+ F1A2 F9                   ld sp,hl
1527+ F1A3 6F                   ld l,a
1528+ F1A4 3E 80                ld a,low push_end - 1           ; (the DI before the last PUSH)
1529+ F1A6 95                   sub l
1530+ F1A7 6F                   ld l,a
1531+ F1A8 26 E1                ld h,high push_end
1532+ F1AA E9                   jp (hl)
1533+ F1AB                      ASSERT high push_blk == high push_end && low push_end - 1 - 128 == low push_blk
1534+ F1AB
1535+ F1AB                      ; Long span: zxnDMA from the fixed colour byte (port A) to HL.
1536+ F1AB                      ; Everything but length and destination was set up by clear_screen.
1537+ F1AB 3C           .dma:   inc a
1538+ F1AC 20 03                jr nz,.dmal
1539+ F1AE 3D                   dec a                           ; 256 wide: length needs the high
1540+ F1AF 18 E3                jr .push                        ; byte, so PUSH it (A = width-1)
1541+ F1B1              .dmal:
1542+ F1B1 4F                   ld c,a

1588+ F1FF              ;==============================================================================
1589+ F1FF              ; Bresenham line, on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
1590+ F1FF              ;   L = x0, H = y0, E = x1, D = y1, colour in line_col.  Preserves IX, IY.
1591+ F1FF              ;   Pages Layer 2 sections into slot 0 as the line crosses them.

1616+ F225 32 3D F2             ld (.smy1),a

1652+ F25B              ;==============================================================================
1653+ F25B              ; Clear the viewport (rows 0..VIEW_H-1) of the back buffer with the zxnDMA,
1654+ F25B              ; one 8K section (32 rows) at a time through slot 0: sky above the horizon
1655+ F25B              ; row, ground below.  The fills are dma_fill's (layer2_cls.asm, resident),
1656+ F25B              ; the l2_fill command block with its destination (port B) and length; the source
1657+ F25B              ; (port A) is the fixed byte l2_cls_byte.  Zero-length fills are skipped.
1658+ F25B              ;==============================================================================

1666+ F265                                                      ; it is all distant wall, and it hides
1667+ F265                                                      ; a 1-row rounding gap under the
1668+ F265                                                      ; wall's top edge when pitched
1669+ F265                  ENDIF

1678+ F273 28 0D                jr z,.gnd

1681+ F277 0E 00                ld c,0

1685+ F27E                  ELSE

1687+ F27E                  ENDIF

1696+ F28D ED 44                neg

1698+ F291 47                   ld b,a
1699+ F292 0E 00                ld c,0
1700+ F294 3E 07                ld a,GROUND_COL

1709+ F2A2                      ; only reloads length low, destination, LOAD and ENABLE.  fill_poly
1710+ F2A2                      ; puts each building's colour in the source byte l2_cls_byte.

1716+ F2AA
1717+ F2AA
1718+ F2AA              ;==============================================================================
1719+ F2AA              ; City traversal - back to front without sorting.
1720+ F2AA              ;   For grid-aligned boxes in separate cells, a box can only hide boxes whose
1721+ F2AA              ;   cell offsets from the camera cell are larger (or equal) on both axes in
1722+ F2AA              ;   the same quadrant.  So: rows from the far edges inwards, and within each
1723+ F2AA              ;   row columns from the far edges inwards, the camera row/column last.
1724+ F2AA              ;==============================================================================
1725+ F2AA              draw_city:
1726+ F2AA CD 65 F3             call walk_patch                 ; this frame's cell steps
1727+ F2AD                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
1728+ F2AD CD EA 84             call occ_begin
1729+ F2B0 3A C1 F8             ld a,(occ_on)
1730+ F2B3 B7                   or a
1731+ F2B4 28 13                jr z,draw_cells                 ; pitched: the painter's order as is
1732+ F2B6 CD 22 85             call occ_cells                  ; front to back: keep what isn't hidden
1733+ F2B9 3A C2 F8             ld a,(occ_full)
1734+ F2BC B7                   or a
1735+ F2BD CA 66 88             jp z,occ_draw_list              ; back to front: draw it
1736+ F2C0 AF                   xor a                           ; too many to keep: draw this frame
1737+ F2C1 32 C1 F8             ld (occ_on),a                   ; the plain way
1738+ F2C4 3E 80                ld a,VIEW_H
1739+ F2C6 32 F5 F8             ld (bld_cut),a                  ; (and nothing cut)
1740+ F2C9                  ENDIF
1741+ F2C9              draw_cells:

1743+ F2CC 21 9A AF             ld hl,view_r
1744+ F2CF 96                   sub (hl)
1745+ F2D0 32 A6 F8             ld (cell_j),a
1746+ F2D3 3A A6 F8     .b:     ld a,(cell_j)
1747+ F2D6 21 63 B6             ld hl,cz
1748+ F2D9 BE                   cp (hl)
1749+ F2DA 28 09                jr z,.f
1750+ F2DC CD 01 F3             call draw_row
1751+ F2DF 21 A6 F8             ld hl,cell_j
1752+ F2E2 34                   inc (hl)
1753+ F2E3 18 EE                jr .b
1754+ F2E5 3A 63 B6     .f:     ld a,(cz)
1755+ F2E8 21 9A AF             ld hl,view_r
1756+ F2EB 86                   add a,(hl)
1757+ F2EC 32 A6 F8             ld (cell_j),a
1758+ F2EF 3A A6 F8     .f2:    ld a,(cell_j)
1759+ F2F2 21 63 B6             ld hl,cz
1760+ F2F5 BE                   cp (hl)
1761+ F2F6 28 09                jr z,draw_row                   ; camera row last
1762+ F2F8 CD 01 F3             call draw_row
1763+ F2FB 21 A6 F8             ld hl,cell_j
1764+ F2FE 35                   dec (hl)
1765+ F2FF 18 EE                jr .f2
1766+ F301
1767+ F301              ; The cell walks (draw_row here, occ_row in city2.asm) keep the cell's
1768+ F301              ; yaw-space centre (X, Z1) in the alternate registers HL', DE' (nothing else
1769+ F301              ; uses the alternate set, the interrupt routine included), and step it one
1770+ F301              ; cell at a time by (cosY, sinY), patched into the steps each frame
1771+ F301              ; (walk_patch).  draw_bld reads it from there.
1772+ F301              draw_row:
1773+ F301 3A A6 F8             ld a,(cell_j)
1774+ F304 FE 40                cp GRID
1775+ F306 D0                   ret nc
1776+ F307 CD 84 F3             call row_base
1777+ F30A 3A 62 B6             ld a,(cx)
1778+ F30D 21 9A AF             ld hl,view_r
1779+ F310 96                   sub (hl)
1780+ F311 32 A5 F8             ld (cell_i),a
1781+ F314 CD A3 F3             call row_start
1782+ F317 3A A5 F8     .l:     ld a,(cell_i)
1783+ F31A 21 62 B6             ld hl,cx
1784+ F31D BE                   cp (hl)
1785+ F31E 28 15                jr z,.r
1786+ F320 CD D0 F3             call try_cell
1787+ F323 21 A5 F8             ld hl,cell_i
1788+ F326 34                   inc (hl)
1789+ F327 D9                   exx                             ; one cell +x: (X,Z1) += (cosY,sinY)
1790+ F328 01 00 00     .cp:    ld bc,0                         ; (cosY: walk_patch)
1791+ F32B 09                   add hl,bc
1792+ F32C EB                   ex de,hl
1793+ F32D 01 00 00     .sp:    ld bc,0                         ; (sinY)
1794+ F330 09                   add hl,bc
1795+ F331 EB                   ex de,hl
1796+ F332 D9                   exx
1797+ F333 18 E2                jr .l
1798+ F335 3A 62 B6     .r:     ld a,(cx)
1799+ F338 21 9A AF             ld hl,view_r
1800+ F33B 86                   add a,(hl)
1801+ F33C 32 A5 F8             ld (cell_i),a
1802+ F33F CD A3 F3             call row_start
1803+ F342 3A A5 F8     .r2:    ld a,(cell_i)
1804+ F345 21 62 B6             ld hl,cx
1805+ F348 BE                   cp (hl)
1806+ F349 CA D0 F3             jp z,try_cell                   ; camera column last
1807+ F34C CD D0 F3             call try_cell
1808+ F34F 21 A5 F8             ld hl,cell_i
1809+ F352 35                   dec (hl)
1810+ F353 D9                   exx                             ; one cell -x
1811+ F354 01 00 00     .cm:    ld bc,0                         ; (cosY)
1812+ F357 B7                   or a
1813+ F358 ED 42                sbc hl,bc
1814+ F35A EB                   ex de,hl
1815+ F35B 01 00 00     .sm:    ld bc,0                         ; (sinY)
1816+ F35E B7                   or a
1817+ F35F ED 42                sbc hl,bc
1818+ F361 EB                   ex de,hl
1819+ F362 D9                   exx
1820+ F363 18 DD                jr .r2
1821+ F365
1822+ F365              ; This frame's (cosY, sinY) into the cell walks' steps (draw_row, occ_row)
1823+ F365              walk_patch:
1824+ F365 2A 40 B6             ld hl,(cos_y)
1825+ F368 22 29 F3             ld (draw_row.cp+1),hl
1826+ F36B 22 55 F3             ld (draw_row.cm+1),hl
1827+ F36E                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
1828+ F36E 22 80 85             ld (occ_row.cp+1),hl
1829+ F371 22 BA 85             ld (occ_row.cm+1),hl
1830+ F374                  ENDIF
1831+ F374 2A 3E B6             ld hl,(sin_y)
1832+ F377 22 2E F3             ld (draw_row.sp+1),hl
1833+ F37A 22 5C F3             ld (draw_row.sm+1),hl
1834+ F37D                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
1835+ F37D 22 85 85             ld (occ_row.sp+1),hl
1836+ F380 22 C1 85             ld (occ_row.sm+1),hl
1837+ F383                  ENDIF
1838+ F383 C9                   ret
1839+ F384
1840+ F384              ; A = cell_j: its row's first city_map byte (city_map + j * GRID) -> cell_row
1841+ F384              row_base:
1842+ F384 6F                   ld l,a
1843+ F385 26 00                ld h,0
1844+ F387                      ROWOFS
1844+ F387 29          >        add hl,hl
1844+ F388 29          >        add hl,hl
1844+ F389 29          >        add hl,hl
1844+ F38A 29          >        add hl,hl
1844+ F38B 29          >        add hl,hl
1844+ F38C 29          >        add hl,hl
1845+ F38D 11 00 70             ld de,city_map
1846+ F390 19                   add hl,de
1847+ F391 22 BC F8             ld (cell_row),hl
1848+ F394 C9                   ret
1849+ F395
1850+ F395              ; HL = v, A = k -> HL = v * k, modulo 65536: exactly v added k times (k
1851+ F395              ; small, its product with each byte of v at most 16 bits).  Keeps BC.
1852+ F395              kmul:
1853+ F395 5F                   ld e,a
1854+ F396 55                   ld d,l
1855+ F397 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; low byte * k
1856+ F399 D5                   push de
1857+ F39A 54                   ld d,h
1858+ F39B 5F                   ld e,a
1859+ F39C ED 30                mul d,e                         ; high byte * k: its low byte counts
1860+ F39E 7B                   ld a,e
1861+ F39F E1                   pop hl
1862+ F3A0 84                   add a,h
1863+ F3A1 67                   ld h,a
1864+ F3A2 C9                   ret
1865+ F3A3
1866+ F3A3              ; Yaw-rotated centre of cell (cell_i, cell_j) -> (X, Z1) in HL', DE' (the
1867+ F3A3              ; cell walks').  Moving one cell (256 units) in x then changes (X, Z1) by
1868+ F3A3              ; exactly the raw (cosY, sinY).
1869+ F3A3              row_start:
1870+ F3A3 3A A5 F8             ld a,(cell_i)
1871+ F3A6 67                   ld h,a
1872+ F3A7 2E 80                ld l,128
1873+ F3A9 ED 5B 80 AF          ld de,(cam_x+1)
1874+ F3AD B7                   or a
1875+ F3AE ED 52                sbc hl,de
1876+ F3B0 22 B4 F8             ld (t_dx),hl
1877+ F3B3 3A A6 F8             ld a,(cell_j)
1878+ F3B6 67                   ld h,a
1879+ F3B7 2E 80                ld l,128
1880+ F3B9 ED 5B 83 AF          ld de,(cam_z+1)
1881+ F3BD B7                   or a
1882+ F3BE ED 52                sbc hl,de
1883+ F3C0 22 B6 F8             ld (t_dz),hl
1884+ F3C3 CD 0B F8             call rot_yaw
1885+ F3C6 E5                   push hl                         ; X
1886+ F3C7 2A B8 F8             ld hl,(t_z1)
1887+ F3CA E5                   push hl                         ; Z1
1888+ F3CB D9                   exx
1889+ F3CC D1                   pop de
1890+ F3CD E1                   pop hl
1891+ F3CE D9                   exx
1892+ F3CF C9                   ret
1893+ F3D0
1894+ F3D0              try_cell:
1895+ F3D0 3A A5 F8             ld a,(cell_i)
1896+ F3D3 FE 40                cp GRID
1897+ F3D5 D0                   ret nc
1898+ F3D6                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
1899+ F3D6 ~                    call vtick                      ; keep the FPS clock sampling
1900+ F3D6                  ENDIF
1901+ F3D6                      ; fall through
1902+ F3D6
1903+ F3D6              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1904+ F3D6              ; Transform and draw the building in (cell_i, cell_j)
1905+ F3D6              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1906+ F3D6              draw_cell:
1907+ F3D6 2A BC F8             ld hl,(cell_row)                ; (the row's first map byte: row_base)
1908+ F3D9 3A A5 F8             ld a,(cell_i)
1909+ F3DC ED 31                add hl,a
1910+ F3DE 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1911+ F3DF 4F                   ld c,a
1912+ F3E0 E6 1F                and CELL_CODE
1913+ F3E2 20 1A                jr nz,.nst
1914+ F3E4                      ; street: the zombies and humans standing there (bits 7, 6)
1915+ F3E4 79                   ld a,c
1916+ F3E5 E6 C0                and CELL_ZOMBIE|CELL_HUMAN
1917+ F3E7 C8                   ret z                           ; nobody
1918+ F3E8                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
1919+ F3E8 3A C1 F8             ld a,(occ_on)
1920+ F3EB B7                   or a
1921+ F3EC 28 08                jr z,.sdraw
1922+ F3EE E5                   push hl
1923+ F3EF CD 18 86             call occ_zombie                 ; level flight: list them
1924+ F3F2 E1                   pop hl
1925+ F3F3 C3 05 86             jp occ_human
1926+ F3F6              .sdraw:
1927+ F3F6                  ENDIF
1928+ F3F6 E5                   push hl
1929+ F3F7 CD 45 26             call zombie_cell
1930+ F3FA E1                   pop hl
1931+ F3FB C3 21 2F             jp human_cell
1932+ F3FE FE 12        .nst:   cp VOID_CODE
1933+ F400 C8                   ret z                           ; out of bounds: never drawn
1934+ F401 79           .bld:   ld a,c                          ; humans on the roof, monsters
1935+ F402 E6 C0                and CELL_ZOMBIE|CELL_HUMAN      ; (ghosts) above it?
1936+ F404 28 21                jr z,draw_bld                   ; nobody
1937+ F406                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
1938+ F406 3A C1 F8             ld a,(occ_on)
1939+ F409 B7                   or a
1940+ F40A 28 0E                jr z,.hdraw
1941+ F40C C5                   push bc
1942+ F40D E5                   push hl
1943+ F40E CD 05 86             call occ_human                  ; listed before the building, so
1944+ F411 E1                   pop hl                          ; drawn after it
1945+ F412 E5                   push hl
1946+ F413 CD 18 86             call occ_zombie
1947+ F416 E1                   pop hl
1948+ F417 C1                   pop bc
1949+ F418 18 0D                jr draw_bld
1950+ F41A              .hdraw:
1951+ F41A                  ENDIF
1952+ F41A E5                   push hl
1953+ F41B CD 27 F4             call draw_bld                   ; the building, then the ghosts
1954+ F41E E1                   pop hl                          ; above it and the humans on its
1955+ F41F E5                   push hl                         ; roof
1956+ F420 CD 45 26             call zombie_cell
1957+ F423 E1                   pop hl
1958+ F424 C3 21 2F             jp human_cell
1959+ F427
1960+ F427              ; The building in the cell at HL (C = its map byte)
1961+ F427              BLD_R           equ 256             ; cull radius: 181 (half diagonal) * sqrt2
1962+ F427              draw_bld:
1963+ F427                      ; Horizontal frustum cull, valid at any pitch: a visible point has
1964+ F427                      ; |X|*c <= Z1 with c = cosP - 0.5|sinP|.  Reject the bounding circle
1965+ F427                      ; (radius BLD_R) round the cell's yaw-space centre (X, Z1, kept up
1966+ F427                      ; to date in HL', DE' by the walk).  First, as it needs nothing else:
1967+ F427                      ; most cells it rejects then cost no more.  (Level flight: c is
1968+ F427                      ; exactly 1.0, so no multiply.)
1969+ F427 E5                   push hl
1970+ F428 C5                   push bc
1971+ F429 D9                   exx                             ; the walk's (X, Z1): HL', DE'
1972+ F42A ED 53 B8 F8          ld (t_z1),de
1973+ F42E 22 BA F8             ld (t_x),hl
1974+ F431 E5                   push hl
1975+ F432 D9                   exx
1976+ F433 E1                   pop hl
1977+ F434 CD 41 AF             call abs_hl
1978+ F437 3A 8A AF             ld a,(pitch)
1979+ F43A B7                   or a

   1+ 8000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 8000              ; Z-POLICE - the second city page (8K page PAGE_CITY2, runs at $8000 in slot
   3+ 8000              ; 4: CITY2_MMU)
   4+ 8000              ;
   5+ 8000              ; More of the Layer 2 drawing, paged in beside the city page (slot 7) for the
   6+ 8000              ; city part of each frame: main_loop maps it over the ULA screen after
   7+ 8000              ; clear_screen and puts the ULA screen back before draw_hud.  Nothing in that
   8+ 8000              ; part of the frame uses the ULA screen (the video hardware shows it from
   9+ 8000              ; bank 5 whatever the CPU has mapped), and the interrupt routine uses only
  10+ 8000              ; slots 1 and 5, so interrupts stay on.  Both pages are mapped together, so
  11+ 8000              ; code and data in either call or use the other directly (labels are global).
  12+ 8000              ;
  13+ 8000              ; Here: the street dots, the bullets, rockets and particles, the gunsight and
  14+ 8000              ; the occlusion culling.  Their variables stay in the city page.  Anything
  15+ 8000              ; that calls into this page from outside main_loop's city part must map it
  16+ 8000              ; first (nextreg CITY2_MMU,PAGE_CITY2) and put the ULA screen back after.
  17+ 8000              ;==============================================================================
  18+ 8000
  19+ 8000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ 8000              ; Street intersection markers - one dot per grid corner near the camera
  21+ 8000              ; whose 4 cells are all open: no building, terrace or pad cell touches it
  22+ 8000              ; (out of bounds counts as open: it is never drawn).  A corner a building
  23+ 8000              ; touches is always drawn over by it (its faces cover their own corners, and
  24+ 8000              ; the box hides those behind it), so it isn't worked out at all.
  25+ 8000              ;   A row's corners have cells j-1 above and j below; each corner shares its
  26+ 8000              ; left pair of cells with the corner before, so one pair is read a corner.
  27+ 8000              ; An open corner's (X, Z1) is its row's first corner's (worked out once, by
  28+ 8000              ; full rotation, only if the row has an open corner) + k (cosY, sinY), k its
  29+ 8000              ; column in the row: exactly what stepping +256 world units k times gives.
  30+ 8000              ;==============================================================================

 712+ 84EA
 713+ 84EA                  IFDEF OCCLUSION_CULL
 714+ 84EA              ;==============================================================================
 715+ 84EA              ; Occlusion culling (OCCLUSION_CULL, level flight only)
 716+ 84EA              ;
 717+ 84EA              ; In level flight every screen column is a vertical slice of the world through
 718+ 84EA              ; the camera.  The cells are walked in exactly the reverse of the painter's
 719+ 84EA              ; order, i.e. front to back.  Each building is transformed as usual, then
 720+ 84EA              ; tested against OCC_YBUF, which holds per column the row from which the
 721+ 84EA              ; screen is known to be covered down to the ground:
 722+ 84EA              ;   * hidden - in every column it spans, its highest point is no higher than
 723+ 84EA              ;     that row - it is dropped;
 724+ 84EA              ;   * otherwise it lowers the row across its columns to its lowest top
 725+ 84EA              ;     corner, and its corners and face settings are kept in a record.
 726+ 84EA              ; The kept buildings and the zombie cells are then drawn back to front.
 727+ 84EA              ; This is safe because buildings that share a column meet the walk front to
 728+ 84EA              ; back (the grid order guarantees it), the camera is above the ground (what
 729+ 84EA              ; is behind sits higher on screen), the cover row is the lowest top corner
 730+ 84EA              ; (an underestimate) and bounds are clamped inwards to the screen.  A
 731+ 84EA              ; building with a corner behind the camera is never dropped and never covers.
 732+ 84EA              ;==============================================================================
 733+ 84EA              OCC_YBUF        equ $4000       ; per column: covered from this row down
 734+ 84EA              OCC_YBUF8       equ $4200       ; per 8 columns: at least the most of
 735+ 84EA                                              ; OCC_YBUF's 8 (its own page, before the
 736+ 84EA                                              ; records), so a hidden test can pass 8
 737+ 84EA                                              ; columns at once
 738+ 84EA              OCC_LIST        equ $4100       ; kept buildings and zombie cells, 2 bytes each
 739+ 84EA              OCC_REC0        equ $43         ; the records' first page; two records a
 740+ 84EA              OCC_RECN        equ $60         ; page (128 bytes each, at +0 and +128), up
 741+ 84EA                                              ; to $5F: 58 records ($6000 on: city_col).
 742+ 84EA                                              ; The busiest street view at the full draw
 743+ 84EA                                              ; distance (8 tiles) keeps 35.
 744+ 84EA              ; Record: copy of vtx's 8 corners, bytes 0-8 of each 16 (X, Y, Z, outcode,
 745+ 84EA              ; sx, sy), at the same offsets from the record's start, and in the first
 746+ 84EA              ; corner's spare bytes
 747+ 84EA              OR_VIS          equ 9           ; bld_vis, bld_mx, bld_mz, col_x, col_z, col_top,
 748+ 84EA              OR_N            equ 7           ;   bld_cut
 749+ 84EA                      ASSERT OR_VIS + OR_N <= 16
 750+ 84EA                      ASSERT bld_cut == bld_vis + OR_N - 1
 751+ 84EA                      ASSERT low OCC_YBUF8 == 0       ; (occ_cut: the low byte is the group)
 752+ 84EA              ; A record in a page's upper half is drawn with the +128 corner lists
 753+ 84EA              ; (face_set = FACE_SET2, city.asm).
 754+ 84EA              ; A list entry is a record's address ($4300-$5FFF), a cell with humans as
 755+ 84EA              ; its city_col address ($6000-$6FFF) or a cell with zombies as its city_map
 756+ 84EA              ; address ($7000-$7FFF).
 757+ 84EA
 758+ 84EA              ; Start of the city: occlusion on only in level flight
 759+ 84EA              occ_begin:
 760+ 84EA AF                   xor a
 761+ 84EB 32 C1 F8             ld (occ_on),a
 762+ 84EE 32 C2 F8             ld (occ_full),a
 763+ 84F1 3A 8A AF             ld a,(pitch)
 764+ 84F4 B7                   or a
 765+ 84F5 C0                   ret nz

 767+ 84F7 32 C1 F8             ld (occ_on),a
 768+ 84FA 21 00 41             ld hl,OCC_LIST

 771+ 8503 22 C5 F8             ld (occ_rp),hl

 773+ 8509 01 00 01             ld bc,256                       ; 1,500 T less than an LDIR), then
 774+ 850C 3E 80                ld a,VIEW_H                     ; the DMA left ready for the spans
 775+ 850E CD FF A7             call dma_fill
 776+ 8511 CD A2 F2             call clear_screen.spans

 778+ 8517 36 80                ld (hl),VIEW_H
 779+ 8519 11 01 42             ld de,OCC_YBUF8+1

 781+ 851F ED B0                ldir

 813+ 8550              ; walk_patch.  Each half starts where draw_row's does and gets to the camera

1077+ 86FE              ; Before the transform: rough screen bounds of the building from its cell
1078+ 86FE              ; centre (t_x, t_z1; at pitch 0 camera Z = Z1), a circle of radius OCC_R
1079+ 86FE              ; around it and its height, each widened by a pixel for rounding.
1080+ 86FE              ; Carry set if those bounds are already hidden.

1405+ 88E1              ;==============================================================================
1406+ 88E1              ; The figures (zombies, special monsters, humans): their graphics are in
1407+ 88E1              ; pages PAGE_GFX0 on (ZPDATA/SPRITES.ZPG, loaded at start-up: gfx_load,
1408+ 88E1              ; level_load.asm; tools/spritefile.py has the format), each mapped at $C000
1409+ 88E1              ; (slot 6: the game logic's, free while the city is drawn) when needed.
1410+ 88E1              ; fig_draw (zombie page) projects the figure and calls spr_lod for its
1411+ 88E1              ; size, then spr_draw.
1412+ 88E1              ;==============================================================================
1413+ 88E1                      ASSERT GFX_ENTRIES*4 <= 256     ; (the purpose table in one 256 bytes)
1414+ 88E1                      ASSERT GFX_ENTRIES == 2*GFX_ANIMS   ; (the purposes, their vision set)
1415+ 88E1                      ASSERT low GFX_DIR == 0
1416+ 88E1
1417+ 88E1              ; The level of detail for the figure's distance: fig_anim's frame fig_frame
1418+ 88E1              ; (wrapped round its frames) at the level whose min_z is the largest not
1419+ 88E1              ; past Z (zt+4; the levels are listed farthest first, the last's min_z 0).
1420+ 88E1              ; In a vision mode (vision_mode not 0) from the vision set: the directory's
1421+ 88E1              ; entries GFX_ANIMS on.  Sets zw, zh, spr_pg and spr_ptr.  Carry set if
1422+ 88E1              ; there are no graphics.

1489+ 8944              ; Draw the level spr_lod chose: zw x zh, centred on column zsx, top row zy
1490+ 8944              ; (rows off the view skipped: it can be negative or past the bottom),
1491+ 8944              ; mirrored if zface bit 1, each pixel its own colour, or spr_col if that
1492+ 8944              ; isn't 0.  A row is its first drawn pixel's column, a count, then each
1493+ 8944              ; pixel's palette entry (0: transparent).  A row wholly on screen goes
1494+ 8944              ; through the quick loop (patched for mirroring and spr_col); one across a
1495+ 8944              ; screen edge checks each pixel.

 341+ E1F7              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 342+ E1F7              ; Layer 2 double buffering with the hardware shadow register.
 343+ E1F7              ;   NextReg $12 = active bank (on screen), NextReg $13 = shadow bank.
 344+ E1F7              ; The game always draws into the shadow bank; l2_flip swaps the two during
 345+ E1F7              ; vertical blank, so the registers themselves record which buffer is which.

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - input: keyboard and joysticks (8K page PAGE_INPUT, runs at
   3+ E000              ; $E000 in slot 7: main_loop and the menu page it in, and the game logic
   4+ E000              ; pages in slot 6 call it)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; Redefinable controls.  An input (a key, or a joystick direction or button)
   7+ E000              ; is a 16-bit code: high byte = input bank, low byte = bit mask within it.
   8+ E000              ;   banks 0-7: the ZX Spectrum keyboard half-rows (port $xxFE, address line
   9+ E000              ;              A8+bank low): read 0 = pressed
  10+ E000              ;   bank 8:    NextReg $B0, Extended Keys 0: read 1 = pressed
  11+ E000              ;   bank 9:    NextReg $B1, Extended Keys 1: read 1 = pressed
  12+ E000              ;   bank 10:   port $1F, Kempston 1 / Mega Drive 1 (J1_*): read 1 = pressed
  13+ E000              ;   bank 11:   port $37, Kempston 2 / Mega Drive 2 (J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  14+ E000              ;   bank 12:   NextReg $B2, the 6-button Mega Drive pads' X, Y, Z and MODE
  15+ E000              ;              (left connector J1_*, right J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  16+ E000              ; A joystick bank is read only while a joystick is set (NextReg $05, the
  17+ E000              ; Next's joystick modes) to the port it reads, else it is 0: so an unused
  18+ E000              ; port can't read as everything pressed.  Joysticks in Sinclair or Cursor
  19+ E000              ; mode enter keys (6-0, 1-5, 5-8) and are read as keys.
  20+ E000              ; kbd_scan, once per frame at the top of the main loop, reads all the banks
  21+ E000              ; into key_now, inverting the ZX rows so that every bank holds 1 = pressed,
  22+ E000              ; and keeps the previous scan in key_prev.  The game asks about actions
  23+ E000              ; (K_FIRE, K_LEFT, ...), not inputs: each action has a key (key_defs) and a
  24+ E000              ; joystick input (joy_defs; 0 = none), either of which works, so both can
  25+ E000              ; be redefined (key_define) at any time.
  26+ E000              ;   key_held    A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input is down
  27+ E000              ;   key_pressed A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input went down
  28+ E000              ;               since the last scan
  29+ E000              ;   key_find    -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (for a
  30+ E000              ;               redefine screen); Z if none
  31+ E000              ;   key_code_pressed  HL = key code -> NZ if that key went down
  32+ E000              ; The Next normally also enters the extended keys into the 8x5 matrix (e.g.
  33+ E000              ; cursor LEFT as CAPS SHIFT + 5).  NextReg $68 bit 4 stops that: set it with
  34+ E000              ; kbd_double_on (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE), clear it with kbd_double_off
  35+ E000              ; (FALSE, the default).
  36+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  37+ E000
  38+ E000              ; --- key codes: bank << 8 | mask ---------------------------------------------
  39+ E000              KB_SHIFT    equ $0001                   ; bank 0: $FEFE
  40+ E000              KB_Z        equ $0002
  41+ E000              KB_X        equ $0004
  42+ E000              KB_C        equ $0008
  43+ E000              KB_V        equ $0010
  44+ E000              KB_A        equ $0101                   ; bank 1: $FDFE
  45+ E000              KB_S        equ $0102
  46+ E000              KB_D        equ $0104
  47+ E000              KB_F        equ $0108
  48+ E000              KB_G        equ $0110
  49+ E000              KB_Q        equ $0201                   ; bank 2: $FBFE
  50+ E000              KB_W        equ $0202
  51+ E000              KB_E        equ $0204
  52+ E000              KB_R        equ $0208
  53+ E000              KB_T        equ $0210
  54+ E000              KB_1        equ $0301                   ; bank 3: $F7FE
  55+ E000              KB_2        equ $0302
  56+ E000              KB_3        equ $0304
  57+ E000              KB_4        equ $0308
  58+ E000              KB_5        equ $0310
  59+ E000              KB_0        equ $0401                   ; bank 4: $EFFE
  60+ E000              KB_9        equ $0402
  61+ E000              KB_8        equ $0404
  62+ E000              KB_7        equ $0408
  63+ E000              KB_6        equ $0410
  64+ E000              KB_P        equ $0501                   ; bank 5: $DFFE
  65+ E000              KB_O        equ $0502
  66+ E000              KB_I        equ $0504
  67+ E000              KB_U        equ $0508
  68+ E000              KB_Y        equ $0510
  69+ E000              KB_ENTER    equ $0601                   ; bank 6: $BFFE
  70+ E000              KB_L        equ $0602
  71+ E000              KB_K        equ $0604
  72+ E000              KB_J        equ $0608
  73+ E000              KB_H        equ $0610
  74+ E000              KB_SPACE    equ $0701                   ; bank 7: $7FFE
  75+ E000              KB_SYM      equ $0702
  76+ E000              KB_M        equ $0704
  77+ E000              KB_N        equ $0708
  78+ E000              KB_B        equ $0710

  80+ E000              KB_LEFT     equ $0802
  81+ E000              KB_DOWN     equ $0804

  83+ E000              KB_PERIOD   equ $0810

  88+ E000              KB_CAPSLOCK equ $0902

  90+ E000              KB_TRUEVID  equ $0908
  91+ E000              KB_INVVID   equ $0910
