  94+ E000              KB_DELETE   equ $0980
  95+ E000              JOY_BANK    equ 10                      ; the first joystick bank
  96+ E000              J1_RIGHT    equ $0A01                   ; bank 10: port $1F (Kempston 1 /
  97+ E000              J1_LEFT     equ $0A02                   ;   Mega Drive 1)
  98+ E000              J1_DOWN     equ $0A04
  99+ E000              J1_UP       equ $0A08
 100+ E000              J1_FIRE     equ $0A10                   ; (Mega Drive: B)
 101+ E000              J1_C        equ $0A20                   ; Mega Drive C, A, START
 102+ E000              J1_A        equ $0A40
 103+ E000              J1_START    equ $0A80
 104+ E000              J2_RIGHT    equ $0B01                   ; bank 11: port $37 (Kempston 2 /
 105+ E000              J2_LEFT     equ $0B02                   ;   Mega Drive 2)
 106+ E000              J2_DOWN     equ $0B04
 107+ E000              J2_UP       equ $0B08
 108+ E000              J2_FIRE     equ $0B10
 109+ E000              J2_C        equ $0B20
 110+ E000              J2_A        equ $0B40
 111+ E000              J2_START    equ $0B80
 112+ E000              J1_MODE     equ $0C01                   ; bank 12: NextReg $B2, 6-button
 113+ E000              J1_Y        equ $0C02                   ;   pads (left connector)
 114+ E000              J1_Z        equ $0C04
 115+ E000              J1_X        equ $0C08
 116+ E000              J2_MODE     equ $0C10                   ;   (right connector)
 117+ E000              J2_Y        equ $0C20
 118+ E000              J2_Z        equ $0C40
 119+ E000              J2_X        equ $0C80
 120+ E000              KEY_BANKS   equ 13
 121+ E000              JP_1F_B     equ 0                       ; joystick ports in use (joy_ports):
 122+ E000              JP_37_B     equ 1                       ;   $1F, $37, the 6-button extras
 123+ E000              JP_MD_B     equ 2
 124+ E000              FALSE       equ 0
 125+ E000              TRUE        equ 1
 126+ E000
 127+ E000              ; --- actions: index into key_defs --------------------------------------------
 128+ E000              K_SPEED_UP  equ 0
 129+ E000              K_SPEED_DN  equ 1
 130+ E000              K_AIRBRAKE  equ 2                       ; air brake: rapid stop
 131+ E000              K_LEFT      equ 3
 132+ E000              K_RIGHT     equ 4
 133+ E000              K_CLIMB     equ 5
 134+ E000              K_DESCEND   equ 6
 135+ E000              K_NOSE_UP   equ 7
 136+ E000              K_NOSE_DN   equ 8
 137+ E000              K_FIRE      equ 9
 138+ E000              K_GUN_UP    equ 10                      ; tilt the centre gun up,
 139+ E000              K_SLOT1     equ 11                      ; select weapon slots 1-5
 140+ E000              K_GUN_DN    equ 16                      ; down,
 141+ E000              K_GUN_CTR   equ 17                      ; and back to the centre
 142+ E000              K_PAUSE     equ 18                      ; pause / resume (main_loop)
 143+ E000              K_BOOST     equ 19                      ; the booster on / off (player.asm)
 144+ E000              K_VISION    equ 20                      ; the next vision mode (vis_cycle)
 145+ E000              K_ACTIONS   equ 21
 146+ E000
 147+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 148+ E000              ; Read all the input banks: key_prev = last scan, key_now = this one, every
 149+ E000              ; bit 1 = pressed
 150+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 151+ E000              kbd_scan:
 152+ E000 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 153+ E003 11 63 E1             ld de,key_prev
 154+ E006 01 0D 00             ld bc,KEY_BANKS
 155+ E009 ED B0                ldir
 156+ E00B 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 157+ E00E 01 FE FE             ld bc,$FEFE                     ; banks 0-7: half-rows $FE..$7F
 158+ E011 ED 78        .row:   in a,(c)
 159+ E013 2F                   cpl                             ; 0 = pressed -> 1 = pressed
 160+ E014 E6 1F                and %00011111
 161+ E016 77                   ld (hl),a
 162+ E017 23                   inc hl
 163+ E018 CB 00                rlc b                           ; next half-row
 164+ E01A 38 F5                jr c,.row                       ; (stops after $7F)
 165+ E01C 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B                     ; banks 8, 9: NextRegs $B0, $B1
 166+ E01F 3E B0                ld a,$B0
 167+ E021 ED 79                out (c),a
 168+ E023 04                   inc b
 169+ E024 ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; already 1 = pressed
 170+ E026 77                   ld (hl),a
 171+ E027 23                   inc hl
 172+ E028 05                   dec b
 173+ E029 3E B1                ld a,$B1
 174+ E02B ED 79                out (c),a
 175+ E02D 04                   inc b
 176+ E02E ED 78                in a,(c)
 177+ E030 77                   ld (hl),a
 178+ E031 23                   inc hl
 179+ E032                      ; banks 10-12, the joysticks: only the ports a joystick is set to
 180+ E032                      ; (NextReg $05), so an unused port can't read as all pressed
 181+ E032 05                   dec b                           ; (BC = $243B)
 182+ E033 3E 05                ld a,$05
 183+ E035 ED 79                out (c),a
 184+ E037 04                   inc b
 185+ E038 ED 58                in e,(c)                        ; the joystick modes
 186+ E03A 7B                   ld a,e                          ; joystick 1: bits 7-6, and bit 3
 187+ E03B 07                   rlca
 188+ E03C 07                   rlca
 189+ E03D E6 03                and 3
 190+ E03F CB 5B                bit 3,e
 191+ E041 28 02                jr z,.j1
 192+ E043 F6 04                or 4
 193+ E045 CD 84 E0     .j1:    call joy_ports
 194+ E048 57                   ld d,a                          ; D: the ports in use (JP_*)
 195+ E049 7B                   ld a,e                          ; joystick 2: bits 5-4, and bit 1
 196+ E04A 0F                   rrca
 197+ E04B 0F                   rrca
 198+ E04C 0F                   rrca
 199+ E04D 0F                   rrca
 200+ E04E E6 03                and 3
 201+ E050 CB 4B                bit 1,e
 202+ E052 28 02                jr z,.j2
 203+ E054 F6 04                or 4
 204+ E056 CD 84 E0     .j2:    call joy_ports
 205+ E059 B2                   or d
 206+ E05A 57                   ld d,a
 207+ E05B AF                   xor a                           ; bank 10: port $1F
 208+ E05C CB 42                bit JP_1F_B,d
 209+ E05E 28 05                jr z,.p1
 210+ E060 DB 1F                in a,($1F)
 211+ E062 CD 95 E0             call joy_sane
 212+ E065 77           .p1:    ld (hl),a
 213+ E066 23                   inc hl
 214+ E067 AF                   xor a                           ; bank 11: port $37
 215+ E068 CB 4A                bit JP_37_B,d
 216+ E06A 28 05                jr z,.p2
 217+ E06C DB 37                in a,($37)
 218+ E06E CD 95 E0             call joy_sane
 219+ E071 77           .p2:    ld (hl),a
 220+ E072 23                   inc hl
 221+ E073 AF                   xor a                           ; bank 12: NextReg $B2, the 6-button
 222+ E074 CB 52                bit JP_MD_B,d                   ; pads' extra buttons
 223+ E076 28 0A                jr z,.p3
 224+ E078 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 225+ E07B 3E B2                ld a,$B2
 226+ E07D ED 79                out (c),a
 227+ E07F 04                   inc b
 228+ E080 ED 78                in a,(c)
 229+ E082 77           .p3:    ld (hl),a
 230+ E083 C9                   ret
 231+ E084                      ASSERT KEY_BANKS == 13 && JOY_BANK == 10
 232+ E084
 233+ E084              ; A = a joystick mode (NextReg $05: 0 Sinclair 2, 1 Kempston 1, 2 Cursor,
 234+ E084              ; 3 Sinclair 1, 4 Kempston 2, 5 Mega Drive 1, 6 Mega Drive 2, 7 I/O) -> A =
 235+ E084              ; the ports it is read through (JP_* bits).  Keeps DE, HL.
 236+ E084              joy_ports:
 237+ E084 E5                   push hl
 238+ E085 21 8D E0             ld hl,joy_mode_ports
 239+ E088 ED 31                add hl,a
 240+ E08A 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 241+ E08B E1                   pop hl
 242+ E08C C9                   ret
 243+ E08D
 244+ E08D              joy_mode_ports:
 245+ E08D 00 01 00 00          db 0, 1<<JP_1F_B, 0, 0, 1<<JP_37_B
 245+ E091 02
 246+ E092 05 06 00             db 1<<JP_1F_B | 1<<JP_MD_B, 1<<JP_37_B | 1<<JP_MD_B, 0
 247+ E095
 248+ E095              ; A = a Kempston / Mega Drive port read -> A, or 0 if it reads left and
 249+ E095              ; right at once (no stick can: nothing there).  Uses C.
 250+ E095              joy_sane:
 251+ E095 4F                   ld c,a
 252+ E096 E6 03                and %00000011
 253+ E098 FE 03                cp %00000011
 254+ E09A 79                   ld a,c
 255+ E09B C0                   ret nz
 256+ E09C AF                   xor a
 257+ E09D C9                   ret
 258+ E09E
 259+ E09E              ; Stop the extended keys also appearing in the 8x5 matrix:
 260+ E09E              ; KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE, NextReg $68 bit 4 = 1
 261+ E09E              kbd_double_on:
 262+ E09E 3E 01                ld a,TRUE
 263+ E0A0 18 01                jr kbd_double
 264+ E0A2
 265+ E0A2              ; Let the extended keys also appear in the 8x5 matrix (the default):
 266+ E0A2              ; KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = FALSE, NextReg $68 bit 4 = 0
 267+ E0A2              kbd_double_off:
 268+ E0A2              kdb_double_off:                         ; (alias: the name as first asked for)
 269+ E0A2 AF                   xor a                           ; FALSE
 270+ E0A3
 271+ E0A3              ; A = TRUE / FALSE: store it, and set NextReg $68 bit 4 to match, keeping
 272+ E0A3              ; the register's other bits
 273+ E0A3              kbd_double:
 274+ E0A3 32 55 E1             ld (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING),a
 275+ E0A6 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 276+ E0A9 3E 68                ld a,$68
 277+ E0AB ED 79                out (c),a
 278+ E0AD 04                   inc b
 279+ E0AE ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; current NextReg $68
 280+ E0B0 CB A7                res 4,a
 281+ E0B2 21 55 E1             ld hl,KBD_STOP_DOUBLING
 282+ E0B5 CB 46                bit 0,(hl)
 283+ E0B7 28 02                jr z,.w
 284+ E0B9 CB E7                set 4,a
 285+ E0BB ED 79        .w:     out (c),a                       ; ($253B: still selects $68)
 286+ E0BD C9                   ret
 287+ E0BE
 288+ E0BE              ; A = action -> NZ if its key or its joystick input is down.  Preserves BC,
 289+ E0BE              ; DE, HL.
 290+ E0BE              key_held:
 291+ E0BE E5                   push hl
 292+ E0BF C5                   push bc
 293+ E0C0 4F                   ld c,a
 294+ E0C1 CD 09 E1             call key_def
 295+ E0C4 A6                   and (hl)
 296+ E0C5 20 05                jr nz,.x
 297+ E0C7 79                   ld a,c
 298+ E0C8 CD 1A E1             call joy_def
 299+ E0CB A6                   and (hl)
 300+ E0CC C1           .x:     pop bc
 301+ E0CD E1                   pop hl
 302+ E0CE C9                   ret
 303+ E0CF
 304+ E0CF              ; A = action -> NZ if its key or its joystick input is down now but wasn't
 305+ E0CF              ; at the last scan.  Preserves BC, DE, HL.
 306+ E0CF              key_pressed:
 307+ E0CF E5                   push hl
 308+ E0D0 C5                   push bc
 309+ E0D1 47                   ld b,a
 310+ E0D2 CD 09 E1             call key_def
 311+ E0D5 CD E4 E0             call def_new
 312+ E0D8 20 07                jr nz,.x
 313+ E0DA 78                   ld a,b
 314+ E0DB CD 1A E1             call joy_def
 315+ E0DE CD E4 E0             call def_new
 316+ E0E1 C1           .x:     pop bc
 317+ E0E2 E1                   pop hl
 318+ E0E3 C9                   ret
 319+ E0E4
 320+ E0E4              ; HL -> key_now[bank], A = mask -> NZ if down now but not at the last scan
 321+ E0E4              ; (a mask of 0, no input: never).  Uses C.
 322+ E0E4              def_new:
 323+ E0E4 4F                   ld c,a
 324+ E0E5 A6                   and (hl)
 325+ E0E6 C8                   ret z                           ; not down
 326+ E0E7 79                   ld a,c
 327+ E0E8 D5                   push de
 328+ E0E9 11 0D 00             ld de,KEY_BANKS
 329+ E0EC 19                   add hl,de                       ; key_prev, same bank
 330+ E0ED A6                   and (hl)
 331+ E0EE D1                   pop de
 332+ E0EF A9                   xor c                           ; down before: Z; new: NZ
 333+ E0F0 C9                   ret
 334+ E0F1
 335+ E0F1              ; HL = a key code (KB_...) -> NZ if that key went down since the last scan
 336+ E0F1              ; (for fixed keys, such as the menu's).  Preserves BC, DE, HL.
 337+ E0F1              key_code_pressed:
 338+ E0F1 E5                   push hl
 339+ E0F2 C5                   push bc
 340+ E0F3 4D                   ld c,l                          ; mask
 341+ E0F4 7C                   ld a,h                          ; bank
 342+ E0F5 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 343+ E0F8 ED 31                add hl,a
 344+ E0FA 79                   ld a,c
 345+ E0FB A6                   and (hl)
 346+ E0FC 28 08                jr z,.x                         ; not down
 347+ E0FE D5                   push de
 348+ E0FF 11 0D 00             ld de,KEY_BANKS
 349+ E102 19                   add hl,de                       ; key_prev, same bank
 350+ E103 A6                   and (hl)
 351+ E104 D1                   pop de
 352+ E105 A9                   xor c                           ; down before: Z; new: NZ
 353+ E106 C1           .x:     pop bc
 354+ E107 E1                   pop hl
 355+ E108 C9                   ret
 356+ E109
 357+ E109              ; A = action -> HL -> key_now[its key's bank], A = its key's mask
 358+ E109              key_def:
 359+ E109 21 70 E1             ld hl,key_defs
 360+ E10C                      ; fall through
 361+ E10C
 362+ E10C              ; HL = key_defs or joy_defs, A = action -> HL -> key_now[the bank], A = mask
 363+ E10C              def_at:
 364+ E10C 87                   add a,a
 365+ E10D ED 31                add hl,a
 366+ E10F 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; mask
 367+ E110 23                   inc hl
 368+ E111 F5                   push af
 369+ E112 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; bank
 370+ E113 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 371+ E116 ED 31                add hl,a
 372+ E118 F1                   pop af
 373+ E119 C9                   ret
 374+ E11A
 375+ E11A              ; A = action -> HL -> key_now[its joystick input's bank], A = its mask (0:
 376+ E11A              ; none)
 377+ E11A              joy_def:
 378+ E11A 21 9A E1             ld hl,joy_defs
 379+ E11D 18 ED                jr def_at
 380+ E11F
 381+ E11F              ; A = action, HL = an input's code: redefine the action's key, or its
 382+ E11F              ; joystick input if the code is a joystick's (bank JOY_BANK on).  Uses B.
 383+ E11F              key_define:
 384+ E11F EB                   ex de,hl
 385+ E120 87                   add a,a
 386+ E121 21 70 E1             ld hl,key_defs
 387+ E124 47                   ld b,a
 388+ E125 7A                   ld a,d
 389+ E126 FE 0A                cp JOY_BANK
 390+ E128 78                   ld a,b
 391+ E129 38 03                jr c,.k
 392+ E12B 21 9A E1             ld hl,joy_defs
 393+ E12E ED 31        .k:     add hl,a
 394+ E130 73                   ld (hl),e
 395+ E131 23                   inc hl
 396+ E132 72                   ld (hl),d
 397+ E133 EB                   ex de,hl
 398+ E134 C9                   ret
 399+ E135
 400+ E135              ; -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (lowest bank, lowest bit); Z
 401+ E135              ; if none.  For a redefine screen.
 402+ E135              key_find:
 403+ E135 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 404+ E138 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; bank
 405+ E13A 7E           .b:     ld a,(hl)
 406+ E13B B7                   or a
 407+ E13C 20 09                jr nz,.got
 408+ E13E 23                   inc hl
 409+ E13F 0C                   inc c
 410+ E140 79                   ld a,c
 411+ E141 FE 0D                cp KEY_BANKS
 412+ E143 20 F5                jr nz,.b
 413+ E145 AF                   xor a                           ; Z: nothing down
 414+ E146 C9                   ret
 415+ E147 06 01        .got:   ld b,1                          ; lowest bit set
 416+ E149 1F           .m:     rra
 417+ E14A 38 04                jr c,.f
 418+ E14C CB 20                sla b
 419+ E14E 18 F9                jr .m
 420+ E150 61           .f:     ld h,c
 421+ E151 68                   ld l,b
 422+ E152 F6 01                or 1                            ; NZ
 423+ E154 C9                   ret
 424+ E155
 425+ E155              ;==============================================================================
 426+ E155              ; Input data
 427+ E155              ;==============================================================================
 428+ E155              KBD_STOP_DOUBLING:
 429+ E155 00                       db FALSE                    ; TRUE: NextReg $68 bit 4 set, extended
 430+ E156                                                      ; keys kept out of the 8x5 matrix
 431+ E156 00 00 00...  key_now:    ds KEY_BANKS                ; this scan, 1 = pressed
 432+ E163 00 00 00...  key_prev:   ds KEY_BANKS                ; the scan before (must follow key_now)
 433+ E170              ; The key and the joystick input of each action, by K_*: the defaults
 434+ E170              ; (key_defaults, joy_defaults), and the ones in use (key_defs, joy_defs:
 435+ E170              ; redefinable on the redefine keys screen, keydef.asm, which can put the
 436+ E170              ; defaults back).  Each set in that order: key_defs, joy_defs, key_defaults,
 437+ E170              ; joy_defaults, one after another (keydef.asm copies all four as one).
 438+ E170                  MACRO KEY_DEFAULTS
 439+ E170 ~                        dw KB_Q                     ; K_SPEED_UP
 440+ E170 ~                        dw KB_A                     ; K_SPEED_DN
 441+ E170 ~                        dw KB_Z                     ; K_AIRBRAKE
 442+ E170 ~                        dw KB_O                     ; K_LEFT
 443+ E170 ~                        dw KB_P                     ; K_RIGHT
 444+ E170 ~                        dw KB_W                     ; K_CLIMB
 445+ E170 ~                        dw KB_S                     ; K_DESCEND
 446+ E170 ~                        dw KB_E                     ; K_NOSE_UP
 447+ E170 ~                        dw KB_D                     ; K_NOSE_DN
 448+ E170 ~                        dw KB_SPACE                 ; K_FIRE
 449+ E170 ~                        dw KB_R                     ; K_GUN_UP
 450+ E170 ~                        dw KB_1, KB_2, KB_3, KB_4, KB_5     ; K_SLOT1..5
 451+ E170 ~                        dw KB_F                     ; K_GUN_DN
 452+ E170 ~                        dw KB_V                     ; K_GUN_CTR
 453+ E170 ~                        dw KB_BREAK                 ; K_PAUSE
 454+ E170 ~                        dw KB_X                     ; K_BOOST
 455+ E170 ~                        dw KB_N                     ; K_VISION
 456+ E170                  ENDM
 457+ E170              ; The joystick defaults: the stick flies (left / right turn, up / down climb
 458+ E170              ; and descend), FIRE (Mega Drive B) fires; a Mega Drive pad's C / A are
 459+ E170              ; speed up / down, START pauses, and a 6-button pad's X is the air brake,
 460+ E170              ; Y / Z nose up / down, MODE the boost.  0: none.
 461+ E170                  MACRO JOY_DEFAULTS
 462+ E170 ~                        dw J1_C                     ; K_SPEED_UP
 463+ E170 ~                        dw J1_A                     ; K_SPEED_DN
 464+ E170 ~                        dw J1_X                     ; K_AIRBRAKE
 465+ E170 ~                        dw J1_LEFT                  ; K_LEFT
 466+ E170 ~                        dw J1_RIGHT                 ; K_RIGHT
 467+ E170 ~                        dw J1_UP                    ; K_CLIMB
 468+ E170 ~                        dw J1_DOWN                  ; K_DESCEND
 469+ E170 ~                        dw J1_Y                     ; K_NOSE_UP
 470+ E170 ~                        dw J1_Z                     ; K_NOSE_DN
 471+ E170 ~                        dw J1_FIRE                  ; K_FIRE
 472+ E170 ~                        dw 0                        ; K_GUN_UP
 473+ E170 ~                        dw 0, 0, 0, 0, 0            ; K_SLOT1..5
 474+ E170 ~                        dw 0                        ; K_GUN_DN
 475+ E170 ~                        dw 0                        ; K_GUN_CTR
 476+ E170 ~                        dw J1_START                 ; K_PAUSE
 477+ E170 ~                        dw J1_MODE                  ; K_BOOST (a 6-button pad's MODE)
 478+ E170 ~                        dw 0                        ; K_VISION
 479+ E170                  ENDM

 482+ E1BC 00 00       >            dw 0                        ; K_GUN_CTR

 482+ E1C0 01 0C       >            dw J1_MODE                  ; K_BOOST (a 6-button pad's MODE)
 482+ E1C2 00 00       >            dw 0                        ; K_VISION
 483+ E1C4                          ASSERT $ - joy_defs == K_ACTIONS*2
 484+ E1C4              key_defaults: KEY_DEFAULTS
 484+ E1C4 01 02       >            dw KB_Q                     ; K_SPEED_UP

 484+ E1EA 04 00       >            dw KB_X                     ; K_BOOST

 485+ E1EE              joy_defaults: JOY_DEFAULTS

# file opened: sprites.asm
   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - hardware sprites, Layer 3 (8K page PAGE_SPRITES, runs at $E000
   3+ E000              ; in slot 7: page it in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; The Next has 128 hardware sprites, each 16x16 pixels from a pattern in the
   6+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory (16K, separate from the Z80's: 64 8-bit patterns of
   7+ E000              ; 256 bytes, one byte per pixel, row by row).  A pattern byte is an index
   8+ E000              ; into the sprite palette; SPR_TRANS ($E3, NextReg $4B) is transparent.  The
   9+ E000              ; sprite palette starts as the identity, so until spr_palette changes it a
  10+ E000              ; pattern byte is simply its RRRGGGBB colour.
  11+ E000              ;
  12+ E000              ; Sprites are drawn above Layer 2 and the ULA (priority S U L) and, with
  13+ E000              ; NextReg $15 bit 1 set, over the border as well, so the sprite screen is
  14+ E000              ; 320 x 256 pixels:
  15+ E000              ;
  16+ E000              ;     x 0..319, y 0..255;  (SPR_SCREEN_X, SPR_SCREEN_Y) = (32, 32) is the top
  17+ E000              ;     left of the 256x192 Layer 2 / ULA screen, (288, 224) its bottom right
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; A sprite's position is its top left pixel.  Coordinates are 9 bits and
  20+ E000              ; wrap round at 512, so they may be negative (two's complement): a sprite at
  21+ E000              ; x = -8 shows its right half at the left edge.  With overlapping sprites,
  22+ E000              ; the higher numbered one is drawn on top.
  23+ E000              ;
  24+ E000              ; Use: sprites_init once (start-up), load patterns with spr_patterns or
  25+ E000              ; from a sprite bank (sprite_data.asm: page the bank into slot 7 and call
  26+ E000              ; its spr_load_bank, from outside slot 7), and a palette with spr_palette
  27+ E000              ; if wanted, then set up sprites in the shadow
  28+ E000              ; table with spr_set / spr_pos / spr_pattern / spr_flags / spr_scale /
  29+ E000              ; spr_hide / spr_show / spr_hide_all, and copy the table to the hardware
  30+ E000              ; once a frame with spr_update.  The table holds the first SPR_COUNT sprites;
  31+ E000              ; the rest stay hidden.
  32+ E000              ;
  33+ E000              ; Attributes, SPR_ATTR (5) bytes a sprite, kept in the table as they are
  34+ E000              ; sent (the 5-byte form):
  35+ E000              ;   +0  x bits 0-7
  36+ E000              ;   +1  y bits 0-7
  37+ E000              ;   +2  bits 7-4 palette offset (added to the pattern byte's top nibble),
  38+ E000              ;       bit 3 x mirror, 2 y mirror, 1 rotate 90 degrees clockwise, 0 x bit 8
  39+ E000              ;   +3  bit 7 visible, bit 6 = 1 (byte +4 follows), bits 5-0 pattern
  40+ E000              ;   +4  bits 4-3 x scale, bits 2-1 y scale (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8), 0 y bit 8
  41+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  42+ E000
  43+ E000              SPR_COUNT       equ 32          ; sprites in the shadow table (max 128)
  44+ E000              SPR_HW          equ 128         ; hardware sprites
  45+ E000              SPR_ATTR        equ 5           ; attribute bytes per sprite
  46+ E000              SPR_PATTERNS    equ 64          ; 8-bit 16x16 patterns in pattern memory
  47+ E000              SPR_SIZE        equ 16          ; pixels, each way (at scale x1)
  48+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_X    equ 32          ; sprite coordinates of the 256x192
  49+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_Y    equ 32          ; screen's top left pixel
  50+ E000              SPR_TRANS       equ $E3         ; transparent pattern byte (NextReg $4B)
  51+ E000
  52+ E000              SPRF_PAL        equ $10         ; flags (attribute +2): palette offset x 16,
  53+ E000              SPRF_XMIRROR    equ $08         ; mirror left-right,
  54+ E000              SPRF_YMIRROR    equ $04         ; mirror top-bottom,
  55+ E000              SPRF_ROT        equ $02         ; rotate 90 degrees clockwise
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              SPR_SLOT_PORT   equ $303B       ; write: select sprite / pattern slot
  58+ E000              SPR_ATTR_PORT   equ $57         ; write: attributes, from the selected sprite
  59+ E000              SPR_PAT_PORT    equ $5B         ; write: pattern bytes, from the selected slot
  60+ E000
  61+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  62+ E000              ; Start-up: sprites on, shown over the border too (the full 320 x 256),
  63+ E000              ; priority S U L; the transparent index; every hardware sprite hidden and the shadow table cleared (all hidden,
  64+ E000              ; pattern 0, at 0,0).
  65+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ E000              sprites_init:
  67+ E000 ED 91 15 0B          nextreg $15,%00001011           ; priority S U L, sprites over the
  68+ E004                                                      ; border (bit 1), visible (bit 0)
  69+ E004 ED 91 4B E3          nextreg $4B,SPR_TRANS
  70+ E008 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT             ; from sprite 0, the 4-byte form
  71+ E00B AF                   xor a                           ; (+3 bit 6 clear): all hidden
  72+ E00C ED 79                out (c),a
  73+ E00E 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
  74+ E010 11 00 02             ld de,SPR_HW*4
  75+ E013 ED 79        .hw:    out (c),a
  76+ E015 1B                   dec de
  77+ E016 7A                   ld a,d
  78+ E017 B3                   or e
  79+ E018 3E 00                ld a,0
  80+ E01A 20 F7                jr nz,.hw
  81+ E01C 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
  82+ E01F 06 20                ld b,SPR_COUNT
  83+ E021 77           .sh:    ld (hl),a                       ; x, y, flags 0
  84+ E022 23                   inc hl
  85+ E023 77                   ld (hl),a
  86+ E024 23                   inc hl
  87+ E025 77                   ld (hl),a
  88+ E026 23                   inc hl
  89+ E027 36 40                ld (hl),$40                     ; hidden, 5-byte form, pattern 0
  90+ E029 23                   inc hl
  91+ E02A 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; scale x1
  92+ E02B 23                   inc hl
  93+ E02C 10 F3                djnz .sh
  94+ E02E                      ; fall through: send it
  95+ E02E
  96+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E02E              ; Copy the shadow table to sprites 0..SPR_COUNT-1.  Once a frame, after the
  98+ E02E              ; changes (best just after the frame flip, so a move doesn't show half done).
  99+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 100+ E02E              spr_update:
 101+ E02E 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 102+ E031 AF                   xor a
 103+ E032 ED 79                out (c),a                       ; from sprite 0
 104+ E034 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
 105+ E037 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
 106+ E039 16 20                ld d,SPR_COUNT
 107+ E03B 06 05        .lp:    ld b,SPR_ATTR
 108+ E03D ED B3                otir
 109+ E03F 15                   dec d
 110+ E040 20 F9                jr nz,.lp
 111+ E042 C9                   ret
 112+ E043
 113+ E043              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 114+ E043              ; Load B 8-bit patterns (256 bytes each) from HL into pattern memory, from
 115+ E043              ; pattern A (0..63).  HL ends past them.
 116+ E043              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 117+ E043              spr_patterns:

 119+ E044 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 120+ E047 ED 79                out (c),a
 121+ E049 0E 5B                ld c,SPR_PAT_PORT

 123+ E04D ED B3                otir
 124+ E04F 15                   dec d
 125+ E050 20 F9                jr nz,.lp
 126+ E052 C9                   ret
 127+ E053
 128+ E053              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 129+ E053              ; Load B colours (8-bit RRRGGGBB) from HL into the sprite palette, from

 134+ E057 ED 92 40             nextreg $40,a

 138+ E05F 10 F9                djnz .lp
 139+ E061 C9                   ret

 142+ E062              ; Sprite A (0..SPR_COUNT-1) in the shadow table.  BC = x, DE = y (sprite
 143+ E062              ; screen, signed 9 bits), H = pattern (0..63), L = flags (SPRF_*).  Shows it.

 145+ E062              spr_set:

 152+ E06E 23                   inc hl                          ; +2: the flags, keeping x bit 8

 155+ E074 5F                   ld e,a

 157+ E076 E6 01                and 1
 158+ E078 B3                   or e

 168+ E084              spr_pos:

 174+ E08B 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; +1 y bits 0-7
 175+ E08C 23                   inc hl
 176+ E08D 78                   ld a,b                          ; +2 bit 0: x bit 8
 177+ E08E E6 01                and 1
 178+ E090 47                   ld b,a
 179+ E091 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 180+ E092 E6 FE                and $FE
 181+ E094 B0                   or b
 182+ E095 77                   ld (hl),a
 183+ E096 23                   inc hl
 184+ E097 23                   inc hl
 185+ E098 7A                   ld a,d                          ; +4 bit 0: y bit 8
 186+ E099 E6 01                and 1
 187+ E09B 57                   ld d,a
 188+ E09C 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 189+ E09D E6 FE                and $FE
 190+ E09F B2                   or d
 191+ E0A0 77                   ld (hl),a

 199+ E0A8 6F                   ld l,a

 213+ E0B7 5F                   ld e,a
 214+ E0B8 7E                   ld a,(hl)

 216+ E0BB B3                   or e

 219+ E0BE
 220+ E0BE              ; Sprite A: scale E across, D down (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8)
 221+ E0BE              spr_scale:

 231+ E0CB 07                   rlca

 252+ E0E4 C9                   ret

 255+ E0E5              spr_hide_all:

 258+ E0EB 06 20                ld b,SPR_COUNT

 260+ E0EF 19                   add hl,de
 261+ E0F0 10 FB                djnz .lp
 262+ E0F2 C9                   ret

 264+ E0F3              ; A = sprite -> HL -> its attributes in the table, +3 for spr_addr3.
 265+ E0F3              ; (The table doesn't cross a 256-byte boundary, so +n is just L + n.)
 266+ E0F3              spr_addr3:
 267+ E0F3 CD FA E0             call spr_addr

 269+ E0F7 23                   inc hl
 270+ E0F8 23                   inc hl

 277+ E102 19                   add hl,de

 281+ E104              ; Sprite data

 284+ E104              ; Bank 0 has the human status sprites, loaded as patterns 0-3 by
 285+ E104              ; sprites_init, after the HUD's passenger markers:
 286+ E104              ;   HSPR_FIELD   0  waiting in the field, not yet rescued: an empty square

  17+ E2A9              ; The compass bar, across the top of the screen in the top border (sprite
  18+ E2A9              ; row COMP_SPR_Y): a tape of marks every 16 yaw units (22.5 degrees), at 2
  19+ E2A9              ; pixels a yaw unit, centred on the heading at sprite x COMP_SPR_CX, across
  20+ E2A9              ; the full 320-pixel width of the sprite screen: 225 degrees (+-COMP_HALF,
  21+ E2A9              ; 80 yaw units).  Marks at the very edges are half off the screen (their x
  22+ E2A9              ; wraps, as sprite x does).  The letters N,
  23+ E2A9              ; E, S, W (red) at 0, 64, 128, 192; a yellow dot at the 45 degree points;
  24+ E2A9              ; a small white dot between.  A white pointer under the bar's middle marks

 101+ E314              ; The human status HUD: a column of hardware sprites, sprite k for human k,
 102+ E314              ; HUD_SPR_X pixels in from the left edge of the 320 x 256 sprite screen,

   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - start-up initialisation (8K page PAGE_INIT, runs at $E000 in

   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Code needed only once, at start-up, kept out of the resident page: start
   6+ E000              ; (zpolice.asm) pages this in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INIT and calls

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - file handling: loading and saving on the SD card (8K page
   3+ E000              ; PAGE_FILE, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in with nextreg
   4+ E000              ; CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE before calling)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; General-purpose routines over the esxDOS / NextZXOS file API (RST $08 with
   7+ E000              ; a function code after it).  Game-specific loading and saving (save games,
   8+ E000              ; high scores, settings) go on top of these.
   9+ E000              ;
  10+ E000              ; The ROM: the divMMC only traps RST $08 while the ROM is paged in at
  11+ E000              ; $0000-$3FFF, but the game keeps other pages there (slot 0: a Layer 2
  12+ E000              ; section or the sine table; slot 1: the zombie page).  So every call pages
  13+ E000              ; the ROM into slots 0 and 1 (fh_rom_in), makes the RST $08, then puts the
  14+ E000              ; game's pages back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off over the call (the
  15+ E000              ; game's IM 2 routine is in slot 1, covered by the ROM, and IY is in use and
  16+ E000              ; slot 2 holds game data, so the ROM's routine must not run either), and
  17+ E000              ; fh_rom_out turns them back on if they were on.
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; Rules for callers:
  20+ E000              ;   * page this in at $E000 (slot 7) first, and call from outside slot 7:
  21+ E000              ;     resident code or a game logic page in slot 6;
  22+ E000              ;   * file names and data buffers must be in $4000-$DFFF: not in slots 0-1
  23+ E000              ;     (the ROM and esxDOS are there during a call) nor slot 7 (this page);
  24+ E000              ;   * file names end with a 0 byte.
  25+ E000              ;
  26+ E000              ; Every routine returns carry clear on success; carry set on failure with
  27+ E000              ; A = the esxDOS error code.  A file that was opened is closed again on
  28+ E000              ; any error in fh_load / fh_save.
  29+ E000              ;
  30+ E000              ; Routines:
  31+ E000              ;   fh_init      get the default drive (call once, before the others)
  32+ E000              ;   fh_open      HL = name, B = mode (FA_*)      -> A = handle
  33+ E000              ;   fh_close     A = handle
  34+ E000              ;   fh_read      A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read
  35+ E000              ;   fh_write     A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
  36+ E000              ;   fh_seek      A = handle, BCDE = offset, L = SEEK_* -> BCDE = position
  37+ E000              ;   fh_size      A = handle                      -> BCDE = file size
  38+ E000              ;   fh_load      HL = name, DE = address, BC = most bytes -> BC = bytes read
  39+ E000              ;   fh_save      HL = name, DE = address, BC = length (created / replaced)
  40+ E000              ;   fh_exists    HL = name -> carry clear if the file exists
  41+ E000              ;   fh_delete    HL = name
  42+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  43+ E000
  44+ E000              ; esxDOS function codes (the byte after RST $08)
  45+ E000              M_GETSETDRV     equ $89             ; A = 0: get the default drive
  46+ E000              F_OPEN          equ $9A
  47+ E000              F_CLOSE         equ $9B
  48+ E000              F_READ          equ $9D
  49+ E000              F_WRITE         equ $9E
  50+ E000              F_SEEK          equ $9F
  51+ E000              F_FSTAT         equ $A1
  52+ E000              F_UNLINK        equ $AD
  53+ E000
  54+ E000              ; F_OPEN modes (B)
  55+ E000              FA_READ         equ $01             ; read
  56+ E000              FA_WRITE        equ $02             ; write
  57+ E000              FA_OPEN_EX      equ $00             ; open an existing file only
  58+ E000              FA_OPEN_AL      equ $08             ; open, or create if it doesn't exist
  59+ E000              FA_CREATE_NEW   equ $04             ; create, fail if it exists
  60+ E000              FA_CREATE_AL    equ $0C             ; create, replacing any existing file
  61+ E000              FA_OVERWRITE    equ FA_WRITE|FA_CREATE_AL   ; for saving a whole file
  62+ E000
  63+ E000              ; F_SEEK modes (L)
  64+ E000              SEEK_START      equ 0               ; from the start of the file
  65+ E000              SEEK_FWD        equ 1               ; forwards from the current position
  66+ E000              SEEK_BACK       equ 2               ; backwards from the current position
  67+ E000
  68+ E000              FSTAT_SIZE      equ 7               ; F_FSTAT buffer: file size, 4 bytes
  69+ E000              FSTAT_LEN       equ 11              ; F_FSTAT buffer length
  70+ E000
  71+ E000              ESX_DEFAULT     equ '*'             ; drive: the default drive
  72+ E000
  73+ E000              ; An esxDOS call: the ROM in at $0000-$3FFF for the RST $08, the game's
  74+ E000              ; pages back after.  Registers in and out are the function's own; flags
  75+ E000              ; and A come back from esxDOS (carry set = error, A = code).
  76+ E000                      MACRO ESXDOS fn
  77+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_in
  78+ E000 ~                    rst $08
  79+ E000 ~                    db fn
  80+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_out
  81+ E000                      ENDM

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - audio (8K page PAGE_AUDIO, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in
   3+ E000              ; with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Sound devices: the Next's TurboSound, three AY-3-8912 chips.  initgame
   6+ E000              ; (initialise.asm) has already set the chip mode to AY (NextReg $06),
   7+ E000              ; turned TurboSound and the internal speaker on (NextReg $08) and the AY
   8+ E000              ; outputs to stereo (NextReg $09).  init_audio then sets every chip to a
   9+ E000              ; known, silent state (at start-up, and on every menu screen: menu_clear).
  10+ E000              ; AY 1 is the VTOL's engines: engine_start here, then the interrupt routine
  11+ E000              ; plays them (engine_tick, interrupts.asm).  AY 2 is the weapons' sound
  12+ E000              ; effects, AY 3 explosions: the game asks for one with ld a,SFX_n / ld
  13+ E000              ; (sfx_req),a (AY 2), ld (sfx2_req),a (AY 3's A and B) or ld (sfx3_req),a
  14+ E000              ; (AY 3's C), and the interrupt plays it (sfx_tick).  (Music would need AY 3
  15+ E000              ; back.)  The interrupt writes the AY ports while eng_on is 1,
  16+ E000              ; so code here writes them only with eng_on 0 (or interrupts off).
  17+ E000              ;
  18+ E000              ; TurboSound ports:
  19+ E000              ;   $FFFD write %1LR111cc: select AY chip cc (AY_CHIP_1..3) with its left
  20+ E000              ;         (L) and right (R) outputs on;
  21+ E000              ;         any value 0..15: select that register of the selected chip
  22+ E000              ;   $BFFD write: the value of the selected register
  23+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  24+ E000
  25+ E000              AY_CTRL_PORT    equ $FFFD           ; chip / register select
  26+ E000              AY_DATA_PORT    equ $BFFD           ; register value
  27+ E000
  28+ E000              ; Chip select ($FFFD): AY_SELECT | AY_LEFT | AY_RIGHT | AY_CHIP_n
  29+ E000              AY_SELECT       equ %10011100       ; bit 7 and bits 4-2 must be set
  30+ E000              AY_LEFT         equ %01000000       ; left output on
  31+ E000              AY_RIGHT        equ %00100000       ; right output on
  32+ E000              AY_CHIP_1       equ %11
  33+ E000              AY_CHIP_2       equ %10
  34+ E000              AY_CHIP_3       equ %01
  35+ E000
  36+ E000              ; AY registers
  37+ E000              AY_TONE_A       equ 0               ; channel A tone period: fine, coarse (4)
  38+ E000              AY_TONE_B       equ 2
  39+ E000              AY_TONE_C       equ 4
  40+ E000              AY_NOISE        equ 6               ; noise period (5 bits)
  41+ E000              AY_MIXER        equ 7               ; tone / noise enable, 0 = on:
  42+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_A    equ %00000001       ;   bits 0-2 tone A-C off,
  43+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_B    equ %00000010
  44+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_C    equ %00000100
  45+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_A   equ %00001000       ;   bits 3-5 noise A-C off
  46+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_B   equ %00010000
  47+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_C   equ %00100000
  48+ E000              AY_VOL_A        equ 8               ; amplitude 0-15 (bit 4: use envelope)
  49+ E000              AY_VOL_B        equ 9
  50+ E000              AY_VOL_C        equ 10
  51+ E000              AY_ENV_FINE     equ 11              ; envelope period
  52+ E000              AY_ENV_COARSE   equ 12
  53+ E000              AY_ENV_SHAPE    equ 13              ; envelope shape
  54+ E000              AY_REGS         equ 14
  55+ E000
  56+ E000              AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD equ %1101        ; envelope: rise once, then hold
  57+ E000              AY_MIXER_INIT   equ AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  58+ E000                                                  ; tones on, noise off
  59+ E000
  60+ E000              ; The engines (AY 1): jet turbines, from n = |speed| (at least 1: the idle,
  61+ E000              ; at zero throttle, sounds as speed 1), 1..SPEED_MAX
  62+ E000              ENG_MIXER       equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  63+ E000                                                  ; A noise only, B and C tone only
  64+ E000              ENG_NOISE0      equ 29              ; A, the roar: noise period 29 - n*13/16
  65+ E000              ENG_NOISE_MUL   equ 13              ;   (29 at idle, a rumble; 7 flat out, a hiss)
  66+ E000              ENG_ROAR_VOL0   equ 4               ;   volume 4 + n*7/32 (4..10)
  67+ E000              ENG_WHINE0      equ 222             ; B, the turbine whine: period 222 - 3n
  68+ E000              ENG_WHINE_STEP  equ 3               ;   (~500 Hz at idle, ~790 Hz flat out)
  69+ E000              ENG_WHINE_VOL0  equ 2               ;   volume 2 + n*7/32 (2..8)
  70+ E000              ENG_VOL_MUL     equ 7               ; the volumes rise by n*7/32 (0..6)
  71+ E000              ENG_DETUNE      equ 2               ; C, the same whine 2 periods lower: the
  72+ E000              ENG_SHIMMER_VOL equ 2               ;   two beat (the turbines' shimmer), 2 quieter
  73+ E000              ; Sound effects (sfx_tick, interrupts.asm): their numbers, and the step codes
  74+ E000              SFX_MG          equ 1               ; the machine gun: one round
  75+ E000              SFX_LASER       equ 2               ; the pulse laser: one pulse (a zap)
  76+ E000              SFX_CHAIN       equ 3               ; the chain gun: one round
  77+ E000              SFX_ROCKET      equ 4               ; a rocket fired: a short woosh
  78+ E000              SFX_MISSILE     equ 5               ; a missile fired: a longer woosh
  79+ E000              SFX_AUTOCANNON  equ 6               ; the autocannon / proximity cannon: one shell
  80+ E000              SFX_BOOM_ROCKET equ 7               ; explosions (AY 3, sfx2_req): a rocket's,
  81+ E000              SFX_BOOM_MISSILE equ 8              ;   a missile's,
  82+ E000              SFX_BOOM_AUTOCANNON equ 9           ;   an autocannon shell's,
  83+ E000              SFX_BOOM_PROX   equ 10              ;   a proximity shell's
  84+ E000              SFX_SPLAT       equ 11              ; a zombie hit (AY 3 channel C, sfx3_req)
  85+ E000              SFX_CRASH       equ 12              ; the VTOL hitting a building (AY 3, sfx2_req)
  86+ E000              SFX_LOCK        equ 13              ; the missile lock: a double beep (AY 2)
  87+ E000              SFX_LAST        equ 13              ; (sfx_table, sfx_data.asm)
  88+ E000              SFX_STEP        equ $FE             ; end of a step: the next, next interrupt
  89+ E000              SFX_END         equ $FF             ; end of the sound
  90+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A_TONE_B equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  91+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only, B tone only
  92+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_AB equ AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  93+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A and B tones only
  94+ E000              SFX_MIX_NOISE_A equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  95+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A noise only
  96+ E000              SFX_MIX_TONE_A  equ AY_NO_TONE_B|AY_NO_TONE_C|AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  97+ E000                                                  ; mixer: A tone only
  98+ E000              SFX_MIX_BOOM    equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  99+ E000                                                  ; AY 3's mixer: A noise, B tone (the
 100+ E000                                                  ; explosions), C tone (the splats)
 101+ E000                      ASSERT AY_REGS < SFX_STEP
 102+ E000
 103+ E000              ENG_FRAC        equ 16              ; the engines' speed (eng_cur) in 1/16 steps:
 104+ E000              ENG_SPIN_UP     equ 4               ;   up by at most 4/16 an interrupt (12.5 steps
 105+ E000              ENG_SPIN_DOWN   equ 2               ;   a second), down by 2/16 (6.25 a second)
 106+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_SPIN_UP > 0 && ENG_SPIN_DOWN > 0
 107+ E000                      ASSERT -SPEED_MIN <= SPEED_MAX
 108+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE0 - SPEED_MAX*ENG_WHINE_STEP > 0 && ENG_WHINE0 + ENG_DETUNE < 256
 109+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_NOISE0 < 32 && ENG_NOISE0 - (SPEED_MAX*ENG_NOISE_MUL)/16 >= 1
 110+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_ROAR_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15 && ENG_WHINE_VOL0 + SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL/32 <= 15
 111+ E000                      ASSERT SPEED_MAX*ENG_VOL_MUL < 256
 112+ E000                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE_VOL0 >= ENG_SHIMMER_VOL
 113+ E000
 114+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 115+ E000              ; Set up the sound devices: each AY chip selected with both outputs, every
 116+ E000              ; register 0 (silent: all volumes 0), then the mixer to tones only and the
 117+ E000              ; envelope to attack-and-hold.  AY 1 is left selected.
 118+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 119+ E000              init_audio:
 120+ E000 AF                   xor a                           ; the engines off first: the interrupt
 121+ E001 32 66 3A             ld (eng_on),a                   ; leaves the AYs alone (interrupts.asm)
 122+ E004 32 67 3A             ld (sfx_req),a                  ; and no sound effect asked for or
 123+ E007 32 6A 3A             ld (sfx2_req),a                 ; playing, on any voice
 124+ E00A 32 6D 3A             ld (sfx3_req),a
 125+ E00D 67                   ld h,a
 126+ E00E 6F                   ld l,a
 127+ E00F 22 68 3A             ld (sfx_ptr),hl
 128+ E012 22 6B 3A             ld (sfx2_ptr),hl
 129+ E015 22 6E 3A             ld (sfx3_ptr),hl
 130+ E018 3E 01                ld a,AY_CHIP_3
 131+ E01A CD 24 E0             call ay_init_chip
 132+ E01D 3E 02                ld a,AY_CHIP_2
 133+ E01F CD 24 E0             call ay_init_chip
 134+ E022 3E 03                ld a,AY_CHIP_1
 135+ E024                      ; fall through
 136+ E024
 137+ E024              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it in stereo, clear it, mixer and envelope
 138+ E024              ay_init_chip:
 139+ E024 CD 5D E0             call ay_select
 140+ E027 16 0D                ld d,AY_REGS-1                  ; registers 13..0 = 0
 141+ E029 7A           .clr:   ld a,d
 142+ E02A 1E 00                ld e,0
 143+ E02C CD 65 E0             call ay_write
 144+ E02F 15                   dec d
 145+ E030 F2 29 E0             jp p,.clr
 146+ E033 3E 07                ld a,AY_MIXER
 147+ E035 1E 38                ld e,AY_MIXER_INIT
 148+ E037 CD 65 E0             call ay_write
 149+ E03A 3E 0D                ld a,AY_ENV_SHAPE
 150+ E03C 1E 0D                ld e,AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD
 151+ E03E C3 65 E0             jp ay_write
 152+ E041
 153+ E041              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 154+ E041              ; The VTOL's engines: jet turbines, not rotors, so a steady roar and whine
 155+ E041              ; rather than a chop.  AY 1, all three channels, kept for them.  They never
 156+ E041              ; stop in play: at zero throttle they idle, as at speed 1.  The interrupt
 157+ E041              ; routine plays them, 50 times a second (engine_tick, interrupts.asm): the
 158+ E041              ; sound's speed spools towards the VTOL's, so pitch and volume rise and fall
 159+ E041              ; smoothly.  (The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is
 160+ E041              ; 109375/P Hz.)
 161+ E041              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 162+ E041              ; Start of each level (next_level): AY 1's mixer for the engines, the sound's
 163+ E041              ; speed 0 (they spool up to the idle), and the interrupt playing them
 164+ E041              engine_start:
 165+ E041 AF                   xor a
 166+ E042 32 66 3A             ld (eng_on),a                   ; (the interrupt off AY 1 meanwhile)
 167+ E045 21 00 00             ld hl,0
 168+ E048 22 71 3A             ld (eng_cur),hl
 169+ E04B 3E 03                ld a,AY_CHIP_1
 170+ E04D CD 5D E0             call ay_select
 171+ E050 3E 07                ld a,AY_MIXER
 172+ E052 1E 31                ld e,ENG_MIXER
 173+ E054 CD 65 E0             call ay_write
 174+ E057 3E 01                ld a,1
 175+ E059 32 66 3A             ld (eng_on),a                   ; the interrupt plays them now
 176+ E05C C9                   ret
 177+ E05D
 178+ E05D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 179+ E05D              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it, with both outputs on
 180+ E05D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 181+ E05D              ay_select:
 182+ E05D F6 FC                or AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT
 183+ E05F 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 184+ E062 ED 79                out (c),a
 185+ E064 C9                   ret
 186+ E065
 187+ E065              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 188+ E065              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected chip.  Keeps D, E, HL.
 189+ E065              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 190+ E065              ay_write:
 191+ E065 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 192+ E068 ED 79                out (c),a
 193+ E06A 06 BF                ld b,high AY_DATA_PORT
 194+ E06C ED 59                out (c),e
 195+ E06E C9                   ret
 196+ E06F

   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Keyboard input, movement along the heading, world-edge clamping and
   5+ C000              ; building collision.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,
   6+ C000              ; PAGE_PLAYER, with the keys page (key_held) in slot 7.

  13+ C000              ;==============================================================================

  17+ C003                      ; remember position in case we fly into something
  18+ C003 21 7F AF             ld hl,cam_x                     ; (and the heading: turning swings
  19+ C006 11 FF C2             ld de,old_pos                   ; the VTOL's nose and tail)

  27+ C018 C3 84 C2             jp vtol_wreck                   ; destroyed: out of control
  28+ C01B              .alive:
  29+ C01B                      ; (keys: kbd_scan has read them; actions from input.asm)
  30+ C01B                      ; --- boost (zpolice.asm: BOOST_*): while on, the speed keys and the
  31+ C01B                      ; air brake don't change the speed, and each frame burns a fuel
  32+ C01B 3A 23 B0             ld a,(boost_on)

  38+ C028 3E 13                ld a,K_BOOST

  40+ C02D 20 06                jr nz,.boff                     ; pressed again: off
  41+ C02F 21 22 B0             ld hl,boost_fuel

  43+ C033 20 0A                jr nz,.bkeep                    ; still burning
  44+ C035 3A 24 B0     .boff:  ld a,(boost_spd)                ; off (or out of fuel): the speed it
  45+ C038 32 8B AF             ld (speed),a                    ; had before
  46+ C03B AF           .bend:  xor a
  47+ C03C 32 23 B0             ld (boost_on),a

  49+ C040 32 0A C3             ld (ab_on),a

  52+ C048 CD CF E0             call key_pressed

  57+ C053 3A 22 B0             ld a,(boost_fuel)

  67+ C069 32 8B AF             ld (speed),a

  91+ C097                      ; nose one pitch step, as a nose key press does: up when braking

 276+ C215              ; IX -> 24-bit position (frac, lo, hi). HL = signed delta in 1/256 units.

 330+ C26C              ; Returns NZ if the VTOL hits a building: its footprint (10 m x 3 m, turned

 347+ C284              ; The VTOL has been destroyed (vtol_dead): the controls do nothing.  It
 348+ C284              ; spins DEAD_SPIN a frame and falls, a unit a frame faster each frame (up
 349+ C284              ; to DEAD_FALL_MAX), until it hits the ground under it (floor_y: the road,
 350+ C284              ; or the highest roof under its footprint).  Once down it lies still for
 351+ C284              ; DEAD_PAUSE frames, then sets game_over (main_loop: the GAME OVER screen,
 352+ C284              ; then the main menu).
 353+ C284              vtol_wreck:

 377+ C2B5 EB                   ex de,hl

 386+ C2C3 22 85 AF     .set:   ld (cam_y),hl
 387+ C2C6 C9                   ret

 395+ C2D2              ; One damping step: move the signed 8.8 pitch (pitch_frac/pitch) towards 0
 396+ C2D2              ; by max(PDAMP_MIN, |whole pitch| * PDAMP_K), stopping exactly at 0.
 397+ C2D2              ; Calculated rather than looked up: the Z80N MUL makes it as quick as a
 398+ C2D2              ; table, and the curve stays editable through the two equates.
 399+ C2D2              pitch_damp:
 400+ C2D2 2A 89 AF             ld hl,(pitch_frac)
 401+ C2D5 7C                   ld a,h
 402+ C2D6 B5                   or l
 403+ C2D7 C8                   ret z                           ; already level
 404+ C2D8 7C                   ld a,h
 405+ C2D9 F5                   push af                         ; sign
 406+ C2DA CD 41 AF             call abs_hl
 407+ C2DD 54                   ld d,h                          ; whole part of |pitch|
 408+ C2DE 1E 00                ld e,PDAMP_K
 409+ C2E0 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = step
 410+ C2E2 7A                   ld a,d
 411+ C2E3 B7                   or a
 412+ C2E4 20 08                jr nz,.sub
 413+ C2E6 7B                   ld a,e
 414+ C2E7 FE 80                cp PDAMP_MIN
 415+ C2E9 30 03                jr nc,.sub
 416+ C2EB 11 80 00             ld de,PDAMP_MIN
 417+ C2EE B7           .sub:   or a
 418+ C2EF ED 52                sbc hl,de
 419+ C2F1 30 03                jr nc,.sgn
 420+ C2F3 21 00 00             ld hl,0                         ; would pass level: stop at 0
 421+ C2F6 F1           .sgn:   pop af
 422+ C2F7 17                   rla                             ; carry = was nose down
 423+ C2F8 DC 3A AF             call c,neg_hl
 424+ C2FB 22 89 AF             ld (pitch_frac),hl
 425+ C2FE C9                   ret

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - weapons page (8K page PAGE_WEAPONS, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Player weapons.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_WEAPONS
   5+ C000              ; (the keys page in slot 7) after
   6+ C000              ; the frame is set up (it uses sin_y/cos_y/sin_p/cos_p) and the zombies have
   7+ C000              ; moved.  Bullet state lives in the resident `bullets` table so that the city
   8+ C000              ; page can draw the tracers (draw_bullets).
   9+ C000              ;
  10+ C000              ; Keys 1-5 select the weapon slot that SPACE fires (wpn_sel: 1 = the centre
  11+ C000              ; slot, 2-5 = the wing pylons).  An empty slot isn't selected: the HUD
  12+ C000              ; flashes it instead (wflash_slot / wflash_t).  What is fitted where is set
  13+ C000              ; on the load-out screen between levels (loadout.asm).
  14+ C000              ;
  15+ C000              ; Machine gun (WPN_GUN, the centre slot): hold SPACE to fire one round every
  16+ C000              ; GUN_INTERVAL frames.  Rounds leave the ship's centre line 0.5 m below the
  17+ C000              ; camera and fly straight along the view direction at 500 m/s until they hit
  18+ C000              ; something.
  19+ C000              ;
  20+ C000              ; Collision, every frame for every round in flight: the path from its last
  21+ C000              ; position to its new one (BULLET_STEP long) is walked cell by cell through
  22+ C000              ; the city grid, in order (a 2D DDA on the horizontal distance s along the
  23+ C000              ; path).  The first thing met ends the path:
  24+ C000              ;   * a building cell: hit where the path enters the cell if it is below the
  25+ C000              ;     roof there (a wall), otherwise where it drops below the roof (the roof);
  26+ C000              ;   * a street cell marked as holding zombies (CELL_ZOMBIE): those in it, each a box
  27+ C000              ;     0.5 m wide and 2 m tall, nearest along the path first;
  28+ C000              ;   * the ground, where the path reaches height 0;
  29+ C000              ;   * leaving the GRID x GRID map: the round is gone.
  30+ C000              ; A round that hits is drawn once at the impact point, then freed.  A zombie
  31+ C000              ; that is hit loses B_DMG hit points; at 0 it is killed (its map blip
  32+ C000              ; removed, its record made inactive).  A rocket also bursts (rocket_blast).
  33+ C000              ;
  34+ C000              ; Rocket pod (WPN_ROCKETS, a wing pylon, ROCKET_SHOTS rockets): rockets are
  35+ C000              ; rounds too (B_KIND = BK_ROCKET), at 150 m/s and drawn as a short white
  36+ C000              ; streak with a yellow trail.  Wherever one stops (a building, the ground,
  37+ C000              ; a zombie) rocket_blast does BLAST_DMG to every zombie, human and base tile
  38+ C000              ; within BLAST_R on each axis, and sprays BLAST_PARTS orange particles.
  39+ C000              ;
  40+ C000              ; Autocannon (WPN_AUTOCANNON, a wing pylon, AUTOCANNON_SHOTS shells): the
  41+ C000              ; machine gun's rounds (B_KIND = BK_AUTOCANNON, drawn as tracers) one every
  42+ C000              ; AUTOCANNON_INTERVAL frames; each bursts where it stops: AUTOCANNON_DMG
  43+ C000              ; within AUTOCANNON_R (3 m) on each axis, AUTOCANNON_PARTS particles.
  44+ C000              ;
  45+ C000              ; Proximity cannon (WPN_PROX, a wing pylon, PROX_SHOTS shells): the
  46+ C000              ; autocannon (B_KIND = BK_PROX), its shells also bursting when they pass within
  47+ C000              ; PROX_R (2 m) of a monster (b_pr widens the monster hit boxes,
  48+ C000              ; cell_zombies); the burst does PROX_DMG within PROX_R on each axis.
  49+ C000              ;
  50+ C000              ; Missile pod (WPN_MISSILE, a wing pylon, MISSILE_SHOTS missiles): as the
  51+ C000              ; rockets (B_KIND = BK_MISSILE, drawn the same) at half the speed; the burst
  52+ C000              ; does MISSILE_DMG within MISSILE_R (1.0 tile) on each axis, and sprays
  53+ C000              ; MISSILE_PARTS particles.  Guided: one fires only with a target locked
  54+ C000              ; (lock_update: the reticule), and turns towards it (msl_steer) at
  55+ C000              ; MISSILE_TURN a frame until it is more than LOCK_RANGE away.
  56+ C000              ;
  57+ C000              ; Damage: each round carries its damage (B_DMG): machine gun GUN_DMG, chain
  58+ C000              ; gun CHAIN_DMG, the laser LASER_DMG a beam frame, a rocket none directly
  59+ C000              ; (only its blast).  A zombie dies when its hit points (+18) run out.
  60+ C000              ;
  61+ C000              ; Positions are world units (1 tile = 20 m = 256 units, 1 m = 12.8).  Along the path,
  62+ C000              ; x = x0 + s*sinY, z = z0 + s*cosY and y = y0 + s*slope, with sinY/cosY the
  63+ C000              ; S7.8 heading at firing and slope = tan(pitch) in S7.8.
  64+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  65+ C000

 215+ C13E 32 67 3A             ld (sfx_req),a                  ; too)

 217+ C142                      ASSERT PROX_INTERVAL == AUTOCANNON_INTERVAL
 218+ C142              .chain: ; chain gun: one round every CHAIN_INTERVAL frames

 220+ C145 D8                   ret c

 222+ C149 D8                   ret c

 229+ C154              ; A chain gun round from IX: the view direction turned by a random angle
 230+ C154              ; of -CHAIN_DEV..+CHAIN_DEV steps (1/256 rad) sideways and up/down
 231+ C154              chain_round:

 241+ C169 67                   ld h,a
 242+ C16A 2E 00                ld l,0

 244+ C16F DD 5E 09             ld e,(ix+B_COS)                 ; sin += round(d * cos / 256)

 249+ C17E DD 5E 07             ld e,(ix+B_SIN)

 272+ C1B9 DD 74 0C             ld (ix+B_SLOPE+1),h
 273+ C1BC C9                   ret
 274+ C1BD
 275+ C1BD              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 276+ C1BD              ; The missile lock, each frame in flight.  With the missile pod selected the
 277+ C1BD              ; reticule is shown (ret_on).  Searching (lock_state 0), it wanders the view.
 278+ C1BD              ; A monster drawn last frame (fig_seen: +31) within LOCK_RANGE of the VTOL
 279+ C1BD              ; along x and z, the nearest, becomes the target (lock_tgt): locking (1),
 280+ C1BD              ; the reticule moves to where it was drawn (+32, +33) at RET_STEP pixels a
 281+ C1BD              ; frame, and after LOCK_TIME frames on it (within LOCK_NEAR) the target is
 282+ C1BD              ; locked (2): the lock tone, and the reticule stays on it.  The target lost
 283+ C1BD              ; (killed, out of view, out of range) it searches again.  Then the drawn
 284+ C1BD              ; marks are cleared for this frame's drawing.
 285+ C1BD              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 286+ C1BD              lock_update:
 287+ C1BD CD 4C C8             call sel_slot
 288+ C1C0 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 289+ C1C1 FE 05                cp WPN_MISSILE
 290+ C1C3 C2 50 C2             jp nz,lock_off
 291+ C1C6 3E 01                ld a,1
 292+ C1C8 32 03 B0             ld (ret_on),a
 293+ C1CB 3A 07 B0             ld a,(lock_tgt)
 294+ C1CE FE FF                cp $FF
 295+ C1D0 28 0B                jr z,.find
 296+ C1D2 CD 80 C2             call lk_rec
 297+ C1D5 CD 8C C2             call lk_valid
 298+ C1D8 30 1C                jr nc,.have
 299+ C1DA CD 73 C2             call lk_lose                    ; the target lost
 300+ C1DD CD D6 C2     .find:  call lk_nearest                 ; a new one?
 301+ C1E0 FE FF                cp $FF
 302+ C1E2 28 42                jr z,.wander
 303+ C1E4 32 07 B0             ld (lock_tgt),a
 304+ C1E7 3E 01                ld a,1
 305+ C1E9 32 06 B0             ld (lock_state),a
 306+ C1EC AF                   xor a
 307+ C1ED 32 08 B0             ld (lock_t),a
 308+ C1F0 3A 07 B0             ld a,(lock_tgt)
 309+ C1F3 CD 80 C2             call lk_rec
 310+ C1F6 CD 12 C3     .have:  call lk_spot                    ; C, B = where it was drawn
 311+ C1F9 3A 06 B0             ld a,(lock_state)
 312+ C1FC FE 02                cp 2
 313+ C1FE 20 0A                jr nz,.move

 315+ C201 32 04 B0             ld (ret_x),a
 316+ C204 78                   ld a,b
 317+ C205 32 05 B0             ld (ret_y),a

 319+ C20A 1E 04        .move:  ld e,RET_STEP
 320+ C20C CD 33 C3             call ret_toward
 321+ C20F 30 50                jr nc,lk_clear                  ; not on it yet
 322+ C211 21 08 B0             ld hl,lock_t
 323+ C214 34                   inc (hl)
 324+ C215 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 325+ C216 FE 1C                cp LOCK_TIME
 326+ C218 38 47                jr c,lk_clear
 327+ C21A 3E 02                ld a,2                          ; locked
 328+ C21C 32 06 B0             ld (lock_state),a
 329+ C21F 3E 0D                ld a,SFX_LOCK
 330+ C221 32 67 3A             ld (sfx_req),a
 331+ C224 18 3B                jr lk_clear
 332+ C226              .wander:
 333+ C226 3A 09 B0             ld a,(wnd_x)
 334+ C229 4F                   ld c,a
 335+ C22A 3A 0A B0             ld a,(wnd_y)
 336+ C22D 47                   ld b,a
 337+ C22E 1E 02                ld e,RET_WANDER
 338+ C230 CD 33 C3             call ret_toward
 339+ C233 30 2C                jr nc,lk_clear
 340+ C235 CD 30 26             call zrand                      ; there: somewhere new, within
 341+ C238 55                   ld d,l                          ; RET_WANDER_R of the view's centre
 342+ C239 1E 51                ld e,2*RET_WANDER_R+1
 343+ C23B ED 30                mul d,e                         ; D = 0..2*RET_WANDER_R
 344+ C23D 7A                   ld a,d
 345+ C23E C6 58                add a,128-RET_WANDER_R
 346+ C240 32 09 B0             ld (wnd_x),a
 347+ C243 54                   ld d,h
 348+ C244 1E 51                ld e,2*RET_WANDER_R+1
 349+ C246 ED 30                mul d,e
 350+ C248 7A                   ld a,d
 351+ C249 C6 18                add a,VIEW_CY-RET_WANDER_R
 352+ C24B 32 0A B0             ld (wnd_y),a
 353+ C24E 18 11                jr lk_clear
 354+ C250                      ASSERT VIEW_CY-RET_WANDER_R >= RET_HALF && VIEW_CY+RET_WANDER_R < VIEW_H-RET_HALF
 355+ C250
 356+ C250              ; No lock, no reticule (another weapon, landed, destroyed)
 357+ C250              lock_off:
 358+ C250 AF                   xor a
 359+ C251 32 03 B0             ld (ret_on),a
 360+ C254 3E 80                ld a,128                        ; next time from the centre
 361+ C256 32 04 B0             ld (ret_x),a
 362+ C259 3E 40                ld a,VIEW_CY
 363+ C25B 32 05 B0             ld (ret_y),a
 364+ C25E CD 73 C2             call lk_lose
 365+ C261                      ; fall through
 366+ C261
 367+ C261              ; Clear every monster's drawn mark (+31)
 368+ C261              lk_clear:
 369+ C261 FD 21 0A 29          ld iy,zombies+31
 370+ C265 06 26                ld b,NMON
 371+ C267 11 22 00             ld de,ZREC
 372+ C26A FD 36 00 00  .lp:    ld (iy+0),0
 373+ C26E FD 19                add iy,de
 374+ C270 10 F8                djnz .lp
 375+ C272 C9                   ret
 376+ C273
 377+ C273              ; No target: searching
 378+ C273              lk_lose:

 380+ C275 32 07 B0             ld (lock_tgt),a
 381+ C278 AF                   xor a
 382+ C279 32 06 B0             ld (lock_state),a
 383+ C27C 32 08 B0             ld (lock_t),a
 384+ C27F C9                   ret
 385+ C280
 386+ C280              ; A = monster index -> IY = its record
 387+ C280              lk_rec:

 389+ C281 16 22                ld d,ZREC
 390+ C283 ED 30                mul d,e
 391+ C285 FD 21 EB 28          ld iy,zombies
 392+ C289 FD 19                add iy,de
 393+ C28B C9                   ret
 394+ C28C
 395+ C28C              ; Monster IY: a target?  In play, not fading out, drawn last frame, and
 396+ C28C              ; within LOCK_RANGE of the VTOL along x and z.  Carry set if not; else HL =
 397+ C28C              ; the larger distance (x or z).
 398+ C28C              lk_valid:

 400+ C290 37                   scf
 401+ C291 C8                   ret z                           ; not seen
 402+ C292                      ; fall through
 403+ C292
 404+ C292              ; As lk_valid, seen or not (a missile's target: msl_steer)
 405+ C292              lk_alive:

 407+ C296 37                   scf

 409+ C298 FD 7E 10             ld a,(iy+16)

 415+ C2A5 D8                   ret c

 425+ C2B4 EB                   ex de,hl
 426+ C2B5 B7                   or a
 427+ C2B6 C9                   ret
 428+ C2B7
 429+ C2B7              ; HL = a point's x: HL = |x - monster IY's x|, carry set if over LOCK_RANGE
 430+ C2B7              lk_dist:

 432+ C2BA FD 56 01             ld d,(iy+1)
 433+ C2BD 18 06                jr lk_d
 434+ C2BF              lk_dist2:                               ; (z)

 442+ C2CF ED 52                sbc hl,de

 445+ C2D3 19                   add hl,de
 446+ C2D4 B7                   or a
 447+ C2D5 C9                   ret
 448+ C2D6
 449+ C2D6              ; The nearest target (lk_valid): A = its index, $FF if none

 465+ C2F8 22 A4 D1             ld (ln_dist),hl
 466+ C2FB 3A A6 D1             ld a,(ln_i)
 467+ C2FE 32 A3 D1             ld (ln_best),a
 468+ C301 11 22 00     .nx:    ld de,ZREC
 469+ C304 FD 19                add iy,de
 470+ C306 3A A6 D1             ld a,(ln_i)
 471+ C309 3C                   inc a
 472+ C30A FE 26                cp NMON
 473+ C30C 38 D8                jr c,.lp
 474+ C30E 3A A3 D1             ld a,(ln_best)
 475+ C311 C9                   ret
 476+ C312
 477+ C312              ; Monster IY -> C, B = where it was drawn (+32, +33), kept so the reticule
 478+ C312              ; stays in the view
 479+ C312              lk_spot:
 480+ C312 FD 7E 20             ld a,(iy+32)
 481+ C315 FE 06                cp RET_HALF

 494+ C32F 3E 79                ld a,VIEW_H-1-RET_HALF
 495+ C331 47           .y2:    ld b,a
 496+ C332 C9                   ret
 497+ C333
 498+ C333              ; Move the reticule towards (C, B) by up to E pixels on each axis: carry
 499+ C333              ; set if it is then within LOCK_NEAR of it on both.  Keeps B, C.
 500+ C333              ret_toward:
 501+ C333 21 04 B0             ld hl,ret_x
 502+ C336 79                   ld a,c
 503+ C337 CD 57 C3             call .ax

 505+ C33D 78                   ld a,b
 506+ C33E CD 57 C3             call .ax
 507+ C341 3A 04 B0             ld a,(ret_x)
 508+ C344 91                   sub c

 510+ C347 ED 44                neg
 511+ C349 FE 04        .p1:    cp LOCK_NEAR+1
 512+ C34B D0                   ret nc
 513+ C34C 3A 05 B0             ld a,(ret_y)

 516+ C352 ED 44                neg

 518+ C356 C9                   ret
 519+ C357 96           .ax:    sub (hl)                        ; A = the way to go
 520+ C358 C8                   ret z
 521+ C359 38 07                jr c,.dn
 522+ C35B BB                   cp e

 528+ C362 ED 44        .dn:    neg

 533+ C369 7E                   ld a,(hl)

 535+ C36B 77                   ld (hl),a
 536+ C36C C9                   ret

 538+ C36D              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 539+ C36D              ; Missile IX, before its step: turn towards its target (B_TGT) by up to
 540+ C36D              ; MISSILE_TURN sideways (B_YAW) and up or down (B_PIT), aiming at its middle
 541+ C36D              ; (MSL_AIM_Y above its feet).  The target gone (killed, fading out) or more
 542+ C36D              ; than LOCK_RANGE from the missile along x or z: no more tracking, it flies
 543+ C36D              ; straight on.  When the turn changes its heading or climb (their high
 544+ C36D              ; bytes), its direction is worked out again (B_SIN, B_COS, B_S, B_SLOPE,
 545+ C36D              ; and the cell spans afresh).

 603+ C3ED 29                   add hl,hl

 636+ C435 B7                   or a

 640+ C43D DD 36 1B FF  .lost:  ld (ix+B_TGT),$FF               ; no more tracking

 644+ C442              ; Bomb (WPN_BOMB, the selected slot's): gun_fire jumps here.  One bomb,
 645+ C442              ; released straight ahead at the VTOL's speed + BOMB_SPEED (at least 1 unit
 646+ C442              ; a frame), gliding down from BOMB_ANGLE, steeper every BOMB_STEEPEN frames
 647+ C442              ; (bomb_steer), to the ground or whatever it hits first.

 729+ C4DB              ; A = the angle wanted, HL = B_YAW or B_PIT: turn missile IX's angle there

 776+ C525
 777+ C525              ; HL = x, DE = z (signed) -> A = the angle of (x, z) from +z towards +x,

   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - main menu (8K page PAGE_MENU, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Shown after start-up.  Layer 2 is hidden and the menu is drawn on the ULA
   5+ C000              ; screen with opaque paper.  Every frame it advances the random number
   6+ C000              ; generator (zrand), so the game doesn't start from the same seed each time
   7+ C000              ; (the wait for a key press varies), then reads the keys:
   8+ C000              ;   1  New game   -> newGame (zpolice.asm): level 1
   9+ C000              ;   2  Continue   -> the save game (made by save and quit, from the pause:
  10+ C000              ;                 game_pause), its level at its wave (load_save,
  11+ C000              ;                 continue_game, zpolice.asm); NO SAVED GAME if there's none
  12+ C000              ;   9  Redefine keys -> keydef_screen (keydef.asm)
  13+ C000              ; game_over_screen (the landing pad destroyed) shows GAME OVER for 10
  14+ C000              ; seconds, then returns here.
  15+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  16+ C000
